title: Lead Commercial Sales
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We want you as a talented Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional to help us in our mission by driving commercial B2B success across our key technologies, Nyx, and future programmes, while supporting our Chief Commercial Officer in expanding our government business outside Europe.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include B2B sales responsibilities:

  • Owning the sales pipeline for key technologies e.g. Additive Manufacturing, Thermal Protection, and Propulsion technologies offered through the "Space Store" as well as supporting the commercialization and expansion plan for European Astrotech (EAL) propulsion services.

  • Identifying, qualifying, and developing customers across satellite operators, launch providers, defense and prime contractors

  • Building technical and commercial proposals with our engineering teams and negotiating contract terms

  • Defining the Space Store go-to-market approach, including positioning, pricing, and sales enablement

  • Leading commercial sales for Nyx cargo and crew services, including commercial station (CLD) and payload opportunities.

  • Developing commercial strategies for future programs, including lunar and launcher offerings

  • Developing a qualified pipeline of future clients for future programs to support bid and fundraising efforts.

  • Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and bid preparation to contract signature and handover to programme teams

  • Supporting the Chief Commercial Officer in developing and executing the sales strategy for government customers outside Europe.

  • Supporting the European and USA Government teams where needed.

  • Preparing responses, capability presentations, and pitch materials

  • Representing the company at trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 8+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, ideally in aerospace, space, defence, or other high-technology industries

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value commercial B2B deals and technical sales, such as hardware, engineering services, or systems

  • Experience selling to government agencies or prime contractors, including international government markets

  • An understanding of technical products such as additive manufacturing, thermal protection, propulsion, or spacecraft systems, and the ability to translate them into customer value

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and proposal-writing skills

  • Fluency in English; additional fluency in German, French, or Italian is a strong advantage, depending on your location

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup or scale-up environment (preferred

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. description:

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you'll be doing:

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

title: Care Expert – QM- & EHR-Beratung ambulante Pflege (Vivendi & MediFox DAN) (m/w/d)
description:
🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB.

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich.

💡 DEINE MISSION

voize arbeitet direkt mit der Pflegesoftware unserer Kunden zusammen. Im ambulanten Dienst dokumentieren Pflegekräfte unterwegs, zwischen zwei Einsätzen und oft unter Zeitdruck. Wie gut voize dort trägt, hängt davon ab, wie Vivendi oder MediFox DAN beim Pflegedienst eingerichtet sind. Genau da setzt du an.

Du kennst mindestens eines der beiden Systeme aus der Praxis eines ambulanten Pflegedienstes oder eines Trägers. Als Care Expert berätst du unsere Kunden, wie ihre Konfiguration aussehen muss, damit Pflegeteams auf Tour mit voize wirklich Zeit zurückgewinnen. Du arbeitest beratend auf Augenhöhe mit QM, Pflegedienstleitung, Einsatzplanung und Anwendungsbetreuung. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Einführungen ohne Reibung laufen und Teams voize nach dem Go-live gern nutzen.

🚀 DEIN ALLTAG

  • Konfiguration prüfen, bevor es zählt: Vor Schulung und Go-live führst du mit QM und Anwendungsbetreuung unsere Dokuchecks durch. Ihr prüft gemeinsam, ob Vivendi bzw. MediFox DAN ambulant zu voize passt, von Klienten- und Leistungsstammdaten über Leistungskomplexe und Einsatzplanung bis zur mobilen Dokumentation.

  • Beraten statt nur prüfen: Wo etwas nicht passt, zeigst du konkrete Lösungen im System. Du bringst Ideen ein, wie Abläufe auf Tour und im Büro des Pflegedienstes einfacher werden.

  • Zwischen Pflege und System übersetzen: Pflegefachliche und vertragliche Anforderungen wie SIS ambulant, Leistungskomplexe nach SGB XI, Behandlungspflege nach SGB V oder Leistungsnachweise machst du in der Konfiguration greifbar, und umgekehrt.

  • Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der Einrichtung im System, am Prozess beim Kunden oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product.

  • Kunden begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager.

  • Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten, Help-Center-Artikel und interne Enablements für Vivendi und MediFox weiter.

🤝 DEIN PROFIL

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre intensiv mit Vivendi oder MediFox DAN ambulant gearbeitet, etwa als Anwendungsbetreuer:in, Key User, QM-Beauftragte:r, Pflegedienstleitung oder in der Einsatzplanung eines ambulanten Pflegedienstes oder Trägers. Funktionen und Konfigurationsmöglichkeiten kennst du im Detail.

  • Kennst du beide Systeme, ist das ein großes Plus. Wenn nicht, hast du Lust, dich schnell in das zweite einzuarbeiten.

  • Du bringst einen pflegefachlichen Hintergrund oder fundierte Erfahrung mit der Pflegedokumentation in der ambulanten Pflege mit: Strukturmodell und SIS ambulant, Leistungserfassung, Behandlungspflege auf ärztliche Verordnung und Anforderungen aus MD-Prüfungen.

  • Du weißt, wie ein ambulanter Dienst tickt: Tourenplanung, Einsätze bei Klient:innen zu Hause, Dokumentation unterwegs und das Zusammenspiel mit Abrechnung und Kostenträgern.

  • Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Einstellungen, Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist.

  • Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedienstleitung genauso wie einer Pflegekraft auf Tour oder der IT-Abteilung eines Trägers.

  • Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft.

  • Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote.

🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize

  • Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt.

  • Du gestaltest eine junge Funktion mit: Das Care-Expert-Team baut gerade seine Arbeitsweise, seine Playbooks und seine Rolle in der Kundenbegleitung auf.

description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description:
DEINE MISSION

Lust, Ernährung neu zu denken? Bei yfood machen wir seit 2017 gutes Essen alltagstauglich – ausgewogen, praktisch und richtig lecker. Mit unseren Produkten haben wir eine eigene Kategorie geformt: Smart Food. In ganz Europa unterwegs, rasant wachsend und immer auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen. Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig.

Du postest eh schon jeden Tag. Mach daraus deinen Job.
Du scrollst nicht nur – du weißt, warum ein Video durch die Decke geht und warum das nächste floppt. Genau dieses Gespür suchen wir. Der Großteil unserer Reichweite entsteht über Creator, nicht über uns selbst – und weil du selbst postest, sprichst du ihre Sprache und zeigst auf unseren eigenen Kanälen das Beste davon.
Die Rolle ist global gedacht: Du denkst unsere Social-Strategie nicht nur für DACH, sondern sparrst dich dabei auch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads, zum Beispiel dem Head of Marketing in UK.

Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Deine Aufgaben als Social Media Manager

  • Strategie, global gedacht: Du entwickelst unsere Social Media Strategie nicht im stillen Kämmerlein in München, sondern im Austausch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads. Du hinterfragst HQ-Vorgaben, wenn UK oder ein anderer Markt etwas anderes braucht, und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie und lokale Realität zusammenpassen.
  • TikTok ist dein zweites Zuhause: Du erkennst Trends, bevor sie durch sind, und weißt sofort, welche Formate zu yfood passen und welche nicht. Instagram und YouTube bespielst du mit, aber TikTok ist dein Hauptrevier.
  • Deine eigenen Kanäle, dein Anspruch: Du verantwortest unsere DACH-Kanäle und zeigst dort die stärksten Creator Videos, Produktlaunches und informativen Content. Qualität vor Quantität.
  • Du sprichst Creator-Sprache: Weil du selbst Content machst, schreibst du Briefings, die Raum für eigene Ideen lassen, und gibst Feedback, das Creator tatsächlich weiterbringt, statt sie nur zufriedenzustellen.
  • Du machst Markenmomente viral: Große Produktlaunches, außergewöhnliche Events und Creator Kampagnen bringst du auf Social und bist dabei auch in den Kommentaren mittendrin statt nur Beobachter.
  • Daten sind dein Vibe-Check: Du planst im Redaktionskalender, schaust auf Watch Time, Saves, Shares und Hook Rate und machst konsequent mehr von dem, was funktioniert.
  • Kein Soloprojekt: Du arbeitest eng mit Content & Comms, Influencer & Creator, Creative, Brand Activation, Performance und E-Commerce zusammen. Social ist bei uns nicht einfach nur ein Kanal, sondern das Betriebssystem.

DAS MACHT DICH AUS

Deine Qualifikationen als Social Media Manager

  • Du bist selbst Social: Aktiv auf TikTok, idealerweise mit eigenem Content – zeig uns gern deinen Kanal. Instagram und YouTube kennst du ebenfalls aus dem Effeff.
  • 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing – ob Brand, Agentur, Start-up oder als Creator. Food, FMCG oder Lifestyle sind ein Plus, kein Muss.
  • Plattform-Fluency: Sounds, Duett/Stitch, Green Screen, Reels, Carousels, Shorts – du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was wo funktioniert und warum.
  • Creator-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Creator ticken, und formulierst Briefings und Feedback so, dass sie auch ankommen.
  • Analyse mit Attitüde: Watch Time, Saves, Shares, Hook-Rate sind für dich Steuerrad, kein Selbstzweck.
  • Deutsch & Englisch fließend.

WAS UNS ANTREIBT

Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus

  • Leidenschaft – Wir brennen für das, was wir tun. Voller Energie, voller Optimismus, immer hungrig nach Neuem.
  • Verantwortung – Heißt für uns: Füreinander einstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und alles geben, wenn’s drauf ankommt.
  • Professionalität – Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst – uns selbst aber nicht zu sehr. Wir sind offen, direkt und immer auf Augenhöhe. Kein Bullshit, kein Ego. Nur Team.
  • Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue Ideen, unkonventionelle Wege – und bleiben nie stehen.

(WH)yfood?

Was wir dir bieten: Unsere Benefits

  • Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
  • yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
  • Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
  • Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
  • yfood hält dich fit. Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
  • Gemeinsam Gutes tun. Mit unserem yforgood Day erhältst du einen bezahlten Tag pro Jahr, um gemeinsam mit deinem Team eine soziale, gemeinnützige oder ökologische Initiative zu unterstützen.
  • Weg vom Fleck. Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
  • Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven. Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
  • Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen. Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
  • Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

KONTAKT

Katharina Bauer
Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

yfood steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. title: Head of Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft.

As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness.

You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service.

  • Define and maintain the propulsion battery system architecture together with the Electrical Systems Architect, ensuring that requirements are correctly allocated, interfaces are controlled, and trade-offs between safety, mass, energy, power, cost and certifiability are made deliberately and documented.

  • Lead, develop and scale the Energy Storage System department, comprising the Airborne Electronics, Airborne Software, Cell Technology, HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration and Thermal Management teams.

  • Recruit, coach and develop team leads and engineers, define clear roles and responsibilities, and align resourcing and hiring plans with the needs of the Microliner programme.

  • Take ownership of key technical decisions, chair design and gate reviews, and escalate programme-level technical risks to the CTO with clear options and recommendations.

  • Own the safety-driven design of the propulsion battery system, including thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and fault tolerance, and work closely with Safety and Systems Engineering on FHA, PSSA, SSA and common-cause analyses.

  • Establish and maintain development processes in line with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, ensuring traceability, configuration control and verification evidence appropriate to the allocated Design Assurance Levels.

  • Shape the certification approach for the propulsion battery system in cooperation with Certification and Airworthiness and represent the ESS team in technical discussions with EASA, including Stage of Involvement (SOI) and compliance reviews.

  • Own the integration of the propulsion battery system with the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the charging and ground infrastructure, including the definition and control of all associated interface requirements.

  • Develop and execute the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system: identify patentable innovations, lead invention disclosures and work with patent counsel on filings, freedom-to-operate assessments and prior-art reviews.

  • Own the PBS department budget, including planning, forecasting and cost control for personnel, hardware, test campaigns and external services.

  • Select and manage key technology suppliers and partners, including cell suppliers, electronics manufacturing partners and suppliers of materials and components, ensuring technical performance, quality and security of supply.

  • Define and oversee the propulsion battery system test strategy, from component and subsystem testing through system-level, environmental, abuse and certification testing, together with the required laboratory and test infrastructure.

  • Prepare the transition from development to series production together with Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain, applying design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly and design-for-test principles.

  • Represent VÆRIDION on technology matters towards authorities, industrial partners, research institutions and funding bodies, and support the preparation and execution of publicly funded research and development projects.

  • Contribute technical expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner and the company’s long-term technology roadmap.

  • Foster an engineering culture defined by technical rigour, accountability, open communication and continuous improvement.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive, Electrochemistry or a related discipline.

  • 15 or more years of professional experience developing complex, safety-critical systems, including at least five years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Proven experience developing high-voltage battery systems for aerospace or automotive applications, from concept through qualification and production.

  • Sound technical understanding of lithium-ion cell technology, battery management systems, high-voltage electrical systems, thermal management and the mechanical integration of battery packs, with the ability to make well-founded decisions across these disciplines.

  • Experience with thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and functional safety concepts for battery systems.

  • Practical experience with aerospace development and certification standards, including ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, is strongly preferred. Familiarity with CS-23 certification is advantageous.

  • A track record of building and scaling engineering organisations, including recruitment, development of team leads and the introduction of structured development processes.

  • Experience with budget responsibility, supplier selection and the management of strategic technology partners.

  • Experience generating and protecting intellectual property, including invention disclosures and collaboration with patent counsel.

  • Experience representing technical programmes towards authorities, partners, funding bodies and other external stakeholders.

  • The ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to engineers, executive management and external stakeholders.

  • A structured, decisive and hands-on leadership style, with the ability to perform in a fast-paced start-up environment.

description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run.

That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Each step up in scale has given the model capabilities it did not have before. The next problems are some of the hardest in AI: filling in the parts of a place no camera saw while marking what was inferred, measuring what changed between visits, and predicting what will change next.

Customers already use the model in production. Energy companies use it to guide field crews to equipment on large industrial sites, defense partners use it for positioning where GPS is jammed or unavailable, and robotics companies train robots in metric-scale copies of the real sites they will work in.

You will be the first product leader for the model and the data it learns from, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You decide which capabilities it gains and in what order, the bar each release has to clear, and what data Niantic Spatial collects, licenses or partners for to get there. You set those priorities directly with the Chief Scientist and the London research team who train the model.

If you have shipped a frontier language model, most of the job will be familiar: evals, data mix and release decisions. The job differs in two ways. Every output of this model can be scored against a measured real place, so its evals rest on ground truth. And its data is collected in the physical world, so choosing what to capture next is a product decision with a real cost. Experience in 3D or mapping is welcome but not required.

By the end of your first year, research, engineering and the product leads for industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers work from one model roadmap that you own, each release ships against evals you wrote, and the model's newest capabilities are in customers' hands.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Model Roadmap - Decide the order in which the Large Geospatial Model gains its next capabilities, from filling in unseen parts of a site to measuring and predicting change, based on what industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers will pay for. Turn customer problems into specific research requirements, and bring new research results to the product leads who sell into each market.

  • Set the Release Bar - Define the evals and acceptance criteria for each capability with the Real-World Test Lab, which measures model output against ground truth in real places. Decide whether each release ships or goes back for more data or training.

  • Own the Data Plan - Decide what data Niantic Spatial collects, buys, licenses or gets through partners, and set the product terms of those deals with Legal and Business Development. Set the curation, labeling, consent, privacy and training-rights requirements every dataset has to meet, and keep a record of which data went into each model version.

  • Turn Capabilities into Products - Decide when a new model capability is ready to become something customers buy, what it promises them, and how it reaches them through Niantic Spatial's products and platform.

  • Set the Long-Term Direction - Decide where the model goes over the next several years, as it moves from describing places as they are to tracking how they change and anticipating what comes next, and make the case for the research and data investment that takes.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, including at least three years shipping a large model to users or customers.

  • Experience writing evals for a model and using them to decide when a release was ready.

  • Direct work on training data, such as setting a data mix, running labeling or human-feedback programs, or negotiating data licenses.

  • Enough depth in how large models are trained, post-trained and evaluated that researchers bring you into their technical decisions. Many strong candidates for this role were ML engineers or researchers before they moved into product.

  • Experience setting direction for research and engineering teams that did not report to you.

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in 3D computer vision, reconstruction, localization, mapping, geospatial data, robotics or autonomous systems.

  • An advanced degree in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or a related field.

  • Experience with Gaussian splatting, neural fields or visual positioning systems.

  • Experience with government or defense requirements for data provenance and security.

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

title: Data Architect
description:
🍊Our mission

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

🍊About the role

The Data Architect owns assigned studies end-to-end, taking full responsibility for both the design of the database on Citrus and the quality of the data it produces, from study planning through database lock. The role designs with the final analysis in mind, writes code where manual review would slow delivery, and designs the edit checks and validation that prevent issues before they make their way downstream. The Data Architect is the technical and data lead for assigned studies and works with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product to ensure each study captures the data its scientific objectives require.

One person owns the database from study planning through lock, so the design and the data it produces never drift apart. The role also shapes how data delivery on Citrus develops, identifying where manual work can be automated.

🍊About you

  • You have around 5+ years of experience across clinical data management and/or trial platform design, with hands-on involvement in study setup, data review, and database lock

  • You work with data programmatically, or are ready to build that skill quickly: Python, R, or SQL are used daily in this role, and you are expected to learn them on the job if you do not already have them

  • Manage the full query lifecycle from generation through resolution, working directly with sites

You'll be joining the Information & Cyber Security team, a core part of our Platform & Security Engineering organisation. Security at Kaluza isn't a silo — you'll work closely with colleagues across security engineering, identity and access management, platform engineering and enterprise technical services.

As the Security GRC Lead, you will serve as the accountable operational owner for Kaluza’s Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance capability. You will establish and maintain a unified Common Control Framework, lead regulatory and framework readiness (including SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 22301), and work with engineering teams to demonstrate effective implementation of controls.

A core focus of this role is acting as the primary information security bridge to Kaluza’s central Risk & Compliance team. What you will be doing

  • Regulatory Impact & Horizon Scanning: Collaborate closely with the Risk & Compliance team to monitor, evaluate, and interpret emerging regulatory changes in the information security, privacy, and critical infrastructure domains.

  • Security Impact Assessments: Translate complex regulatory developments into actionable security control requirements and risk assessments for Kaluza, specifically covering:

    • Emerging Tech & Governance Standards: AI management and governance expectations (ISO 42001).

  • Enterprise Risk Integration: Partner with Risk & Compliance to ensure security and resilience risks, control gaps, and regulatory exposures seamlessly flow into and align with the enterprise risk management (ERM) framework. Maintain high data accuracy across the security risk register to support board-level visibility.

  • Common Control Framework: Design, build, and maintain a single Common Control Framework (anchored initially on ISO 27001 Annex A) mapped across all regulatory, framework, and client contractual requirements.

  • Standards & Policy Suite: Help continuously improve Kaluza's security policy and standards library.

  • Continuous Control Monitoring: Shift Kaluza from point-in-time evidence gathering to automated control monitoring using commercial GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta), making audit readiness a natural byproduct of daily operations.

  • SOC 2 Type 2 Programme: Lead the gap assessment, control build-out, and sustained observation period required for Kaluza’s SOC 2 Type 2 commitment.

  • Standards Maintenance: Oversee continuous alignment with ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 to prevent posture drift between annual audit cycles.

  • Governance Reporting: Draft security reporting for internal leadership committees and forums, ensuring alignment with enterprise-wide reporting standards set by Risk & Compliance.

  • Client Security Assurance: Own client security reporting commitments and streamline response workflows for client questionnaires and external audits.

  • External Partner Coordination: Direct and manage external GRC consultants (e.g., Cydea) to execute audit operations and supplier assessments efficiently.

What you will have

  • Core Framework Expertise: Hands-on experience implementing and managing ISO 27001, ISO 22301, and SOC 2 Type 2 frameworks.

  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Sound understanding of UK/EU cybersecurity laws, critical infrastructure mandates (e.g., NIS2, CSRB, CAF), and emerging tech governance.

  • Tooling & Risk Management: Experience working with automated GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata) and managing risk registers aligned with enterprise risk taxonomies.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated experience partnering with enterprise Risk, Legal, or Compliance teams to analyze and operationalize complex regulatory requirements.

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

Unlocking Technical Innovation: Your work takes compliance administration away from senior engineers, enabling them to focus on core platform innovation like AI security architecture and multi-tenant scaling. Role purpose

The Senior Analyst, Underwriting Quality Control (QC) will establish and continually improve a consistent, risk-based quality control framework for work completed by Underwriters. The role will build on existing QC practices and tools, tailoring them to the Underwriting lifecycle, products, risk decisions and operating model.

The role provides an objective, evidence-led check that underwriting assessments and outcomes are complete, consistent, appropriately documented and aligned with internal policy, procedures and applicable requirements. It will turn review results into clear management information, actionable feedback, targeted training and measurable improvements in underwriting quality.

This is a hands-on role. The Senior Analyst will conduct QC reviews, maintain the framework and reporting, follow findings through to verified remediation, and work with Underwriters and leaders to address recurring gaps. The role reports to the Director of Underwriting and influences quality across the function without replacing the Underwriter’s decision-making accountability.

Key responsibilities

Build and own the QC framework

  • Assess existing QC materials, controls, data and workflows; identify what should be retained, improved or introduced for Underwriting.

  • Design, document and implement an Underwriting-specific QC framework, including scope, risk-based sampling, review cadence, test scripts, scoring and severity definitions, evidence standards, escalation routes, dispute handling, calibration and remediation expectations.

  • Tailor testing to the relevant underwriting stages, products, merchant and business models, risk tiers and applicable regional requirements.

  • Define practical service levels and ownership for review, feedback, acknowledgement, remediation, re-review and closure, agreeing these with Underwriting leadership.

  • Establish appropriate governance and records so that QC decisions and remediation are traceable and ready for internal or external review.

Perform and calibrate QC reviews

  • Review completed underwriting cases and test whether the case record is complete, and appropriately documented. Depending on case scope, this may include business model products, services and geographies; ownership, control and beneficial ownership; company and identity evidence; KYC/KYB and screening outcomes; licences and regulatory status; financial and operational evidence and accurate system records.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent, stale or insufficient evidence, and opportunities to improve decision quality.

Drive remediation and constructive challenge

  • Communicate findings promptly, clearly and fairly to the relevant Underwriter and manager, with evidence and an actionable explanation of what needs to change.

  • Track acknowledgement, corrective action and deadlines; proactively chase overdue responses and escalate unresolved or repeat issues.

  • Work with Underwriters and leaders to understand root causes and ensure remediation addresses the underlying issue, not only the individual case.

Reporting, insight and continuous improvement

  • Produce regular, accurate QC reporting for Underwriting leadership, with clear commentary on coverage, pass and defect rates, severity, recurring themes, remediation status, turnaround and trends by relevant team, workflow, product or risk segment.

  • Support internal audit, Compliance, Risk and other assurance requests by providing accurate QC records and explaining methodology and outcomes.

Build underwriting capability

  • Identify capability gaps from QC findings and partner with Underwriting leaders and relevant subject-matter experts to design and deliver focused training, coaching and practical guidance.

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate is a rigorous and constructive quality professional who can build a practical control framework, apply it consistently and influence experienced Underwriters. They combine sound KYC/KYB judgement with strong analytical and reporting skills, confidence in following through on remediation, and the ability to turn case-level observations into improvements across a regional operation.

Essential

  • Significant experience in underwriting, merchant due diligence, AML/KYC/KYB, onboarding, financial crime operations, quality control, quality assurance or a related risk function within financial services, payments or fintech.

  • Practical understanding of UK and EEA due diligence requirements, with familiarity across the US, Canada, Singapore, Hong Kong, UAE, Australia and New Zealand; ability to recognise jurisdictional differences and escalate interpretation questions appropriately.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement or materially improve a QC, QA, control testing or file review framework.

  • Strong reporting and data skills, including spreadsheets, pivot tables and clear management reporting; experience with Looker dashboard or business intelligence tools is an advantage. Use of AI is a plus.

  • Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the persistence to chase remediation and escalate overdue or repeat issues appropriately.

  • Experience delivering training or coaching based on quality control findings.

Nice to Have

  • Direct exposure to underwriting or due diligence in a merchant acquiring setting.

  • Familiarity with case management and CRM tools,dashboard platforms.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; recognised AML, financial crime or compliance qualifications (for example ACAMS or ICA) are beneficial but not mandatory.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As a Full-stack Engineer, you'll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

The technical challenges

  • Volumetry and efficiency: We handle more than 2.5 million medical encounters per month. Each one is automatically turned into a clinical note sent to the clinician's patient record system, saving thousands of hours of administrative work and giving healthcare professionals more time for their patients.

  • Real-time audio transcription: capturing and streaming audio reliably, from in-person visits as well as video consultations, and turning it into transcripts with very low latency

  • Resilience: keeping the product working on weak or unstable networks, with no data lost and no disruption to the clinician

  • Healthcare integrations: building robust connections to the third-party medical systems clinicians already rely on.

  • Complex AI services: designing and running multi-stage LLM pipelines and agentic workflows at scale, with the reliability and auditability a clinical setting requires

These challenges come with demanding product requirements:

  • Zero friction: clinicians have no time to learn a new tool, so the product must be fast to set up, intuitive, and useful from the very first consultation

  • Trust: what we generate goes into patient records, so quality and reliability are non-negotiable

  • Works everywhere: web, desktop and mobile, in clinics, hospitals or remote consultations

Your impact

  • Build and improve product features across web, desktop and mobile platforms

  • Design and evolve the back-end APIs and services that power them

  • Collaborate closely with Product, ML, and Design to take projects from idea to production

  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to team best practices

  • Learn from senior engineers and grow your skills across the stack

Your DNA

  • Solid foundations in Computer Science

  • 4+ years of industry experience in full-stack engineering

  • Proficient in React (strong Vue.js experience also considered)

  • Proficient in at least one back-end language such as Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#/.NET, Go, or Rust. We use Kotlin internally, and it's fine if you haven't worked with it yet

  • Comfortable working with AI coding tools and agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), and keen to use AI in your day-to-day work

  • Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a fast-moving team

  • Care about code quality and maintainability

  • Enjoy working in an international team where English is our primary language

Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Rust, Electron

  • Backend: Kotlin / JVM, GraphQL, PostgreSQL

  • ML & Infra: Python, PyTorch, Slurm, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers)

Remote policy: 2 days a week

Possibility of working abroad remotely up to 2 weeks, once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business.

Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team.


What you’ll do:

1. Build and diversify our capacity panel

  • Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
  • Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers.
  • Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement.
  • Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year.
  • Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk.

    •  

    2. Build strong carrier partnerships

  • Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level.
  • Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations.
  • Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels.
  • Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time.
  • Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market.

    •  

    3. Shape products and build the function

  • Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products.
  • Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications.
  • Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution.
  • Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting.
  • Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk.
  • Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows.

    • What you’ll bring:
  • At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier.
  • A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers.
  • A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications.
  • Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market.
  • The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail.
  • Fluent English.

    • Strong advantage:
  • Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures.
  • Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z.
  • Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment.
  • German or French proficiency.
  • Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function.
    • If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you.
    🤝 What we offer in return:
    🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions.
    💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office.
    🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home.
    🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office.
    ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to.
    🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually
    ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy.
    🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams.
    ✈️  Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues.
    🚂  Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office.
    🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days.
    🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs.
    👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life.
    ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review).
     
    🏁 Our recruitment process
    We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps:
     
    Step 1 - Your motivation
    To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team.
    Step 2 - Role fit
    In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager.
    Step 3 - Case study
    For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities.
    Step 4 - Our culture connect
    Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision.
     
    Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you!
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance.
    At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us.
    With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together.
    Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity.

Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter.

Build and validate models

title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
description:
Über VIA HealthTech

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat.

Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf.

Die Rolle

Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus.

In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht.

Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.
  • Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen.
  • Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt.
  • Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert.
  • Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut.
  • Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF.
  • Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen
  • Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle
  • Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden
  • Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt
  • Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert
  • Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen
  • Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2), auch Schweizerdeutsch, gutes Englisch
  • Verfügbarkeit am frühen Abend. Unsere Zielgruppe ist häufig erst nach der letzten Sitzung erreichbar, Termine zwischen 17 und 19 Uhr gehören dazu. Im Gegenzug gestaltest du deinen Tag frei

Von Vorteil

  • Französisch und/oder Italienisch, um später auch die weiteren Gebiete anzusprechen
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der Schweizer Psychotherapie- oder Psychiatrieszene
  • Erfahrung mit Funnels, in denen Marketing und Vertrieb ineinandergreifen: Performance-Marketing, Webinare, Trials, Self-Service
  • Anerkennung als Psychotherapeut:in, psychologische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen
  • Vertriebserfahrung mit Praxen, Heilberufen oder Spitälern in der Schweiz
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Sales-Automation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder Outbound-Tooling
  • Erfahrung im Markteintritt oder Aufbau eines Vertriebs von 0 auf 1

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du ein Team suchst, das für dich telefoniert.
  • Du eine fertige Pipeline oder ein bestehendes Länderteam erwartest. Du baust beides.
  • Du weder Hunger noch besonderen Ehrgeiz mitbringst. Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team und stellen entsprechend ein.

Was wir bieten

  • Einen Markt, den du prägst. Du bist die erste Person von VIA in der Schweiz. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament unseres Schweizer Geschäfts
  • Ein Team, das überperformt. DACH-Marktführer für KI-Assistenz in der Psychotherapie in zwei Jahren, bootstrapped. Unsere Pläne von hier sind deutlich grösser, und wir stellen Menschen ein, die das mitgestalten wollen
  • Hohe Autonomie und Erfolgsbeteiligung. Bei uns zählen Kompetenz und Umsetzung. Wir legen dir keine Steine in den Weg, und du verdienst an dem, was du aufbaust
  • Attraktives Paket. Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum in CHF plus ungedeckelte Provision, dazu Beteiligung am Unternehmen
  • Direkter Draht. Du arbeitest täglich mit den Gründern und dem multidisziplinären Team, Entscheidungen fallen in Stunden statt in Wochen
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit. Jede Praxis, die du gewinnst, bedeutet mehrere Stunden pro Woche, die wieder Patient:innen zugutekommen
  • Flexibel arbeiten. Remote aus der Schweiz, freie Zeiteinteilung, moderne Ausstattung und regelmässige Teamtage in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte

Wir suchen keine:n klassische:n Vertriebler:in, sondern eine:n Macher:in, die oder der mit Hunger und Hands-on-Mentalität VIA in der Schweiz zur ersten Wahl macht.
