title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

  • Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code

  • Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms

  • Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire

🧭 Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end

  • Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints

  • Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible

  • Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback

📈 Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services

  • Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes

  • Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times

  • Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation


You should have

  • Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend.

  • Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, and some exposure to Node.js backends. Familiarity with any of Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, React Query, ShadCN, AWS (Lambda, SQS, RDS, ECS), Jest or Playwright is useful; we don't expect all of it.

  • Experience: exposure to GDS systems (like Amadeus) or travel aggregator platforms is a plus.

  • Do your best work, with leading-edge AI tools for all team members

  • Benefit from support and budget for your learning and development

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys organized work, clear communication, and getting the details right. You’ll start with established playbooks and test procedures, then help improve them as you learn the product and settle into the team.

  • Run activation workflows. Follow provider-specific manuals to submit onboarding requests and coordinate registrations, approvals, and contracting steps with identity providers. Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

  • Collect evidence and report results. Gather tester feedback and supporting evidence, check outcomes against the expected user flow, and produce clear reports showing what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what still needs attention.

  • Raise issues and follow through. Turn test findings into actionable issues with reproduction steps and relevant evidence. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and provider-facing teams, track progress, and arrange retesting when fixes are ready. You don’t need to fix the underlying code yourself, but you do need to keep the follow-up moving.

  • Keep people and information aligned. Maintain accurate records of activation status, test coverage, schedules, and blockers. Keep customers, testers, and internal teams informed, and flag missing information or schedule risks early.

  • You are good at gathering and structuring information. You can turn scattered feedback, screenshots, and observations into a clear test report or issue that someone else can act on. You distinguish confirmed findings from things that still need investigation.

  • You have practical technical curiosity. You can learn your way around APIs, credentials, configuration settings, and test versus production environments. You don’t need to be a developer or an identity expert, but you should be comfortable reading documentation and following technical instructions.

Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Aufträge, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst ein eigenes Book von rund 70 bis 90 Generalunternehmern, Bauträgern und Planern und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Consulting-Team eine erfolgreiche Aktivierung sicher. Du sicherst die Verlängerung, baust Nutzung und Vertrag aus und merkst früh, wenn ein Kunde abrutscht. Wo ein Kunde noch nicht richtig angekommen ist, holst du ihn gemeinsam mit dem Consulting-Team in die Nutzung.

Verlängerungen, Upgrades und Cross-Sell verhandelst du selbst, mit Geschäftsführung, Einkauf und Kalkulation. Jede Vertragsfrist der nächsten zwölf Monate hast du im Blick, ab 120 Tagen davor läuft dein Renewal-Ablauf, und deinen Forecast pflegst du jede Woche.

Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades.

  • Die Kündigungen in deinem Book liegen unter deinem Ziel, und jede Frist der nächsten zwölf Monate hat eine Renewal-Opportunity mit Forecast-Kategorie.

  • Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Warnsignale in deinem Book, etwa sinkende Nutzung oder ein weggefallener Key User, haben schnell einen Plan.

  • Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger.

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung.

  • SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird.

  • LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand.

  • Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert.

  • Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements.

  • Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen.

Dein Profil

  • 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist.

  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen.

  • Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst.

  • Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt.

  • Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Deine Benefits

  • Eigene Kanäle und Themen ab Tag eins, mit klarem Entwicklungspfad hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Marketing

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Agenturschleifen

  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen

  • Arbeitsplatz in unserem Bonner Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen

  • Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (Artikel, Posts, Landingpages, Newsletter – was zeigt, wie du arbeitest). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht; ein paar Sätze dazu, warum Marketing für ein RegTech dich reizt, reichen. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag – zum Beispiel ein LinkedIn-Post zu einem regulatorischen Thema –, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns!

description:
Über Vestlane und die Rolle

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Du willst sehen, wie ein B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen wirklich funktioniert – nicht aus der Folie, sondern aus dem Maschinenraum? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne den Umweg über drei Jahre Investment Banking? Du baust lieber einen Prozess, der ein Problem dauerhaft löst, als es jede Woche neu zu lösen? Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools und Automatisierung so selbstverständlich wie andere mit Excel? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Founders Associate arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Operations und Go-to-Market verantwortet. Du übernimmst die operativen Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Prozessen und Tooling über Finance und Compliance bis HR – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die das Unternehmen bewegt. Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins, direkter Draht zu Steuerberatung, Dienstleistern und Partnern, und ein Überblick über ein wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen, den dir kein Konzern bietet. 2–3 Tage pro Woche arbeitet ihr gemeinsam vor Ort im Raum Erfurt/Weimar, an einem Arbeitsplatz, den du von Anfang an mit aufbaust; den Rest flexibel aus dem Home-Office.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Die interne Maschine bauen (dein Schwerpunkt): Du dokumentierst, standardisierst und automatisierst unsere internen Abläufe – von einem Wiki, das tatsächlich gelesen wird, über KI-Agenten für wiederkehrende Aufgaben bis zur Verwaltung unserer Tool- und Vendorlandschaft (Verträge, Zugänge, Kosten). Du erkennst, wo wir Zeit verlieren, und beseitigst die Ursache.

  • Entscheidungen vorbereiten: Du baust Analysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für COO und CEO – Unit Economics, Markt- und Wettbewerbsrecherchen, Investorenreporting – und lieferst Zahlen statt Meinungen.

  • Finance und Accounting unterstützen: Du übernimmst die vorbereitende Buchhaltung, prüfst und stellst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlungsläufe vor, arbeitest unserer Steuerberatung zu und hältst Kosten- und Liquiditätsübersichten aktuell.

  • Compliance-Operations am Laufen halten: Du pflegst Nachweise und Richtlinien für ISO 27001 und SOC 2, bereitest Audits vor und hältst unsere Subprozessorenliste und Fristen in Ordnung.

  • Hiring und HR mittragen: Du schreibst Stellenanzeigen, screenst Bewerbungen, koordinierst Interviews und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen sauber onboarded werden – von Arbeitsvertrag und Equipment bis zum ersten Tag. Daneben hältst du unsere HR-Prozesse und -Tools in Ordnung.

  • Verträge und Angebote im Griff behalten: Du bereitest Angebote vor, hältst unsere Pipeline in Salesforce aktuell und behältst Kunden-, Partner- und Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge im Blick – Versionen, Fristen, Unterschriften.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht oder vergleichbar) oder eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung. Ob frisch von der Uni oder mit ein bis zwei Jahren Erfahrung aus Startup, Beratung oder Finanzbranche: Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen, Haltung zählt mehr.

  • Sehr sicher in Excel/Google Sheets, strukturiert in Dokumentation und Projektmanagement. Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Buchhaltungs- oder Automatisierungstools (z. B. Zapier, Make, n8n) ist ein Plus.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT o. ä.) nicht nur zum Texten, sondern um Prozesse zu bauen – und du weißt, wo du selbst prüfen musst.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und gutes Englisch – Partner, Dienstleister und Teile des Teams arbeiten auf Englisch.

  • Präzision und Pragmatismus: Du arbeitest selbstständig, fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, und weißt, wann es auf jedes Detail ankommt – und wann nicht.

title: Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
description:
Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us!

👋 About the Role

We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features.

This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly.

You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it.

What you will do

  • Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment.

  • Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need.

  • Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers.

  • Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans.

  • Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it.

  • Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable.

  • Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language.

  • Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security.

How we work

These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements.

  • Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach.

  • Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services.

  • Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected.

  • Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus.

  • Strong frontend expertise: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and a modern component framework (Vue 3 / Nuxt preferred).

  • Product and UX sense: A track record of designing clean, functional interfaces and delivering features without dedicated PMs or designers.

  • Data-driven mindset: Hands-on experience setting up and using analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar).

  • Daily use of AI coding agents: Active experience with agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot), a clear method for guiding them, and a clear method for checking what they produce.

  • Testing and review habits: Experience with automated E2E and UI testing (Playwright, Cypress, Vitest), the ability to define a testing strategy, and the discipline to review code, yours and others', before it merges.

  • Clear communication: Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable presenting ideas to non-technical stakeholders and working through written proposals.

Strong plus

  • Domain background: Prior experience in fintech, Web3 / digital assets or data-driven products.

  • Design systems: Experience building or maintaining a component library.

  • Backend / BFF capability: Experience building APIs and BFF layers, ideally with PHP / Laravel.

  • Cloud and DevOps: Practical experience with AWS environments, deployments and observability.

  • AI tooling workflow: Experience creating agent skills or CI guardrails for AI-assisted development.

Our stack

TypeScript · Vue 3 · Nuxt · PHP · Laravel · AWS · AI-assisted development workflows

Benefits

  • Offsites with the team in exciting locations

  • Flexible working hours in a company that relies on remote work

  • Exciting product in a very dynamic market environment as well as founding-level ownership of a key growth function.

  • Values-based start-up culture

  • Many opportunities to develop further and network with committed people

  • Flat hierarchy

At the heart of Sparta is a serious data engineering challenge. We're looking for experienced data engineers who are familiar with these challenges at scale — people who understand what it takes to keep a data platform performing as complexity increases.

We want people who thrive with ownership. At Sparta, you'll be handed problems, not solutions - and we expect you to run with them. At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

description:
We are looking for a Principal to lead global campaign operations at Prosci. You will turn Marketing plans for our Individual and Enterprise audiences into consistent, well-built campaigns across regions. 

You will own how campaigns are planned, built, tested and measured in HubSpot. You will direct a specialist partner team, and set the standards that let regional marketers move quickly while maintaining quality and governance. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be our senior Marketing-side expert in campaign operations and HubSpot, setting the operating model, standards and quality bar while directing specialist delivery support. You should be comfortable building and troubleshooting when needed, but your main job is making the whole campaign operation work well at scale.

Requirements

What you will do 

  • Partner with Individual, Enterprise and regional Marketing leaders to translate demand strategy into scalable campaign execution 
  • Own the end-to-end campaign process, from brief and plan to build, launch, QA and measurement, across email, nurture, webinars, events and landing pages 
  • Set global campaign standards, templates and processes that regional teams can use with confidence 
  • Act as the senior Marketing expert on how HubSpot is used for campaigns, including audiences, segmentation and automation 
  • Direct and quality-check the work of our specialist partner team 
  • Define campaign measurement requirements, and make sure every campaign has the right taxonomy, tracking and data structure so Marketing can understand what is working 
  • Own Marketing campaign activation across the website, including landing pages, forms, conversion paths and related content updates, working with Digital Experience on platform, development and broader website improvements 
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and standardize campaign operations, including appropriate use of AI 
  • Work with RevOps on lifecycle, routing and CRM data, and with reporting partners on what needs measuring 
  • Enable regional marketers to execute more independently, with clear standards, templates and guardrails 


What you bring 

  • 7+ years in marketing operations, including campaigns across multiple regions or markets 
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: workflows, lists, segmentation, email, landing pages and forms 
  • A working understanding of how HubSpot and Salesforce connect, and the judgment to know when a problem belongs with the CRM team 
  • Experience directing agency or partner teams and holding them to a clear quality standard 
  • A strong QA instinct: you catch the issue before it reaches a customer or a report 
  • Strong campaign measurement fluency, including tracking, UTMs, attribution concepts and the data foundations required for reliable analysis 
  • Clear writing, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues 


Nice to have 

  • HubSpot certifications 
  • Experience with consent and privacy requirements across regions, including GDPR 
  • Experience supporting ABM or BDR-led motions 
  • Localization and multilingual campaign experience 
  • Practical use of AI tools to automate or speed up campaign work 


How you will work with other teams 

Revenue Systems owns shared CRM administration and governance. Digital Experience leads the website platform and technical roadmap. Reporting partners own routine reporting delivery. You will work closely with each of these teams to make campaigns effective, measurable and well run. 

Your first 90 days 

  1. First 30 days: learn the campaign estate, the partner model and regional needs, and see where QA currently catches problems 
  1. By 60 days: run the campaign process end to end, and set the briefing and QA rhythm with the partner team 

By 90 days: establish the initial global campaign standards, templates and operating rhythm, and agree campaign measurement requirements with Marketing leadership and reporting partners 

Work Location: Remote within the US.


Compensation: $86,400 - $108,000 USD is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate's overall qualifications and experience. This role is eligible for inclusion in our bonus program.


Benefits: Through our experience and strategic focus on the people side of change, we know that by taking care of our people, we are taking care of our business. title: Security & Compliance Engineer – GRC & Product Security – Security and IT Team
description:
About Scality

Scality solves organisations' biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable.


The job context

The team

Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers.

You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience.

The mission

You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering. 

You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations.


The job description

You will own (Responsible)

  • Security operations coordination: be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team.
  • Vulnerability management: Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation.
  • ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 programs: maintain the framework, policies and procedures in our GRC tool. Run risk analysis and treatment plans, objectives and indicators, and the Statement of Applicability. Prepare internal and external audits and follow up on nonconformities and improvement opportunities.
  • Control management: run the monthly, quarterly and annual controls (account and access reviews across HR system and SSO, application access, offboarding checks), automate them in Jira and keep audit evidence.
  • ISMS processes: run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires).
  • Third-party and application security reviews: assess new SaaS tools, suppliers and internal applications or automations (no-code tools, Slack or AI integrations). Keep the supplier inventory and the service account inventory up to date.
  • AI governance: maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act).
  • Personal data: maintain the personal data inventory and processing records (GDPR, CNIL guidance) together with the data protection contact.
  • Customer trust: answer security questionnaires and RFPs, and prepare evidence packages for customer audits (banking, telecom and public-sector customers).
  • Security awareness: plan and run awareness and phishing campaigns, and track participation and click rates for managers.

    • You will contribute to (Contributor)

  • Product security and certifications: prepare the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical files per product (compliance matrix, risk assessment, SBOM, vulnerability handling, RACI). Also contribute to CISA Secure by Design commitments and UK Cyber Essentials. Bring security input to the product roadmap, the development teams and the product documentation.
  • Data leak prevention: define and tune DLP indicators and alerts (Google Workspace, Salesforce event monitoring) and investigate alerts.
  • Infrastructure security: IaaS/PaaS security, monitoring and SIEM alerting, reporting of security incidents, business continuity and disaster recovery.
  • Automation and tooling: scripts (Python, Bash) and Jira automations that reduce manual work.
  • IT operations: account, application and permission management, level 1 and 2 network and security incidents.
  • Mentoring: onboard and supervise interns or work-study students on security topics.

    • You will be informed of

    Laptop fleet and IT room hardware, SSO integration and SaaS administration, level 3 network management, CI security, and relations with external IT providers. Other team members handle these topics.


    Desired profile

    In general

  • Degree in cybersecurity, information systems or equivalent experience
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in information security, GRC or security operations
  • Based in France

    • Technical skills

  • Practical experience with ISO 27001 (2022): risk analysis, Statement of Applicability, controls, internal or certification audits
  • Knowledge of risk methodologies (ISO 27005, EBIOS RM or similar)
  • Understanding of vulnerability management: CVE, CVSS, SBOM, reading scan and pentest reports
  • Basic knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, SAML/OIDC, MFA, access reviews)
  • Ability to assess the security of a SaaS tool or an application: data flows, permissions, data retention, use of data for AI training
  • Jira (workflows, automation) and spreadsheets for control tracking
  • Python or Bash scripting for automation
  • Clear writing for policies, procedures and answers to customers

    • Bonus skills

  • ISO 42001, EU AI Act or AI risk management (e.g. ISO 23894)
  • EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, CISA Secure by Design, UK Cyber Essentials
  • GDPR and personal data inventories
  • DLP, SIEM, centralized logging and monitoring
  • Linux, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Terraform, Packer, SaltStack
  • Experience in a software vendor and with enterprise customers' security audits

    • Personal skills

  • Organized and rigorous: you run many topics in parallel and follow each one to closure
  • Autonomous and proactive: you follow up with other teams without waiting to be asked
  • Good communicator, able to explain security requirements to non-experts and convince them
  • Curious, eager to learn new norms and regulations as they come out
  • Willing to share knowledge and guide interns

    • Languages

  • Fluent French (the team is based in France)
  • Professional English: daily work with US teams; all policies, documentation and many customer questionnaires are in English

    • Our tools

    GRC platform (OverSecur), Jira and Confluence, OneLogin SSO, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, BambooHR, phishing simulation and awareness platform, internal CVE/SBOM platform, Grafana, vSphere, Terraform, Packer, SaltStack, Python and Bash.

title: Clinical Solutions Consultant

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés, vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés, vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés

• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team. Feeling met sport en cijfers? Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby!

Het finance team 
Het zeskoppige finance team, onder leiding van Martijn, draagt met elkaar zorg voor alle financiële processen binnen de organisatie. Zoals je je wellicht kunt voorstellen is de event/travelbranche een dynamisch speelveld waarbij geen dag hetzelfde is. Aan het finance team de taak om in samenwerking met de rest van de organisatie te zorgen voor kloppende cijfers waarop gestuurd kan worden.

Finance & Control stage 
Gedurende je stage zal je compleet onderdeel zijn van het team en zorgen we voor een gevarieerd takenpakket. Je eerste weken staan in het teken van kennismaken met onze processen en werkwijzes. Daarna zul je aan de slag gaan met je eigen takenpakket. Hierbij kun je denken aan:

  • Maken van periodieke en ad hoc rapportages; 

  • Meewerken aan financiële maand- en jaarafsluitingen;

  • Uitvoeren van checks en controles op o.a juistheid en volledigheid van financiële data en processen; 

  • Maken van resultaatboekingen op events en het analyseren daarvan.

Naast het op doen van waardevolle ervaring in de organisatie gaan we graag met je in gesprek over grote en uitdagende projecten die P1 en jou verder helpt in de ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld het zelf opzetten van managementrapportages. 


Jouw profiel 

  • Je volgt momenteel een financiële studie in de richting van Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfsadministratie, Finance & Control o.i.d. en bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage per januari/februari 2027.

  • Je bent pro-actief, wil zoveel mogelijk leren en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal.

  • Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook! 


Waar kom je terecht?

We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 80 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. Je zult dus zeker niet de enige zijn die van start gaat. 


Dit krijg jij ervoor terug!

Naast een afwisselende stage en goede begeleiding wordt er verder goed voor je gezorgd. Denk hierbij aan een gaaf kantoor voorzien van alle gemakken, verzorgde lunch, sportmogelijkheden en de vetste uitjes met de hele toko. Elke stagiair die wij hebben gehad kijkt terug op een onvergetelijke tijd. 


''It’s all about unforgettable experiences!''

title: Workforce & Business Analyst
description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope.

This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support.

You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success.

What you'll ship

  • Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget.

  • Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations.

  • Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence.

  • Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend.

  • Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle.

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field.

  • You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight.

  • Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained.

  • Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar).

  • You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it.

  • You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Tech Lead (C# .NET - SaaS & Low-Code), €5.500 - €7.000 | Zoetermeer
description:
Ben jij een ervaren ontwikkelaar en leider die graag de technische richting bepaalt én zelf aan de knoppen zit? Als Tech Lead bouw jij samen met het team van ontwikkelaars aan schaalbare cloudoplossingen waarmee dagelijks honderden organisaties slimmer en efficiënter werken. Jij bent een technisch zwaargewicht die de kwaliteit, performance en toekomstbestendigheid van onze moderne SaaS-architectuur bewaakt. Je gaat over de technische beslissingen rondom ons eigen low-code platform en bent dé kartrekker van de groep. Jouw keuzes hebben directe impact op techniek, product én de toekomst van digitale documentverwerking.

Jij maakt het mogelijk

Onze groei vraagt om robuuste, veilige en altijd beschikbare services. Als Tech Lead merk je direct waar risico’s ontstaan: complexiteit loopt op, schaalbaarheid komt in gevaar en technische schuld vraagt om leiderschap. Jij stuurt bij vóórdat klanten het merken. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst.

Je kijkt verder vooruit dan de volgende release en je durft jezelf en het team uit te dagen. Daarnaast coach je de ontwikkelaars uit het team technisch en neem je initiatief om onze producten verder te brengen. Je bent de kartrekker van de groep, en schakelt laagdrempelig met onze product owners, engineering manager en andere development teams.

Concreet betekent dit dat jij:

+ Leiding neemt over het low-code platform ontwikkelteam;

+ Samen met dit team ontwikkelt aan ons low-code platform, op basis van wensen vanuit de operatie én technische eisen voor future-proofing;

+ Als senior de codekwaliteit verhoogt door coaching, code-reviews en kennisdeling;

+ Actief meebouwt aan architectuurkeuzes, coding standards en automatisering in uitrol;

+ Kwaliteit borgt via tests, monitoring en goede documentatie;

+ Continu zoekt naar verbeteringen m.b.t. schaalbaarheid, stabiliteit, performance, security;

+ Samen met collega’s zoals ontwikkelaars, product owners en engineering managers spart over oplossingsrichtingen;

+ Wanneer nodig onze collega’s van consultancy en support helpt om complexe problemen met ons low-code platform op te lossen;

+ Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal bestaande maatwerkprojecten en indien nodig niet terugdeinst voor een nieuwe maatwerk opdracht.

Hoe jouw werkweek eruitziet

Op maandag spar je met de teamleden en zorg je ervoor dat iedereen weet waar ze aan moeten werken, en dat ze daar ook verder mee kunnen. Je pakt zelf een wijziging op die vraagt om een nieuwe schaalbare service en je denkt direct mee over architectuur en security-impact. Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking.

"Bij Whitevision hebben we meer dan 20 jaar aan rijke software-ontwikkeling achter ons liggen. Wat begon als een flexibele oplossing, is uitgegroeid tot een essentieel platform met integraties in diverse ERP-systemen. Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer).



Jij hebt het

+ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Back-end Developer, waarvan een deel in een Lead of minstens Senior rol;

+ Coaching-ervaring en de drive om technisch leiderschap te tonen;

+ Uitgebreide kennis van C#, .NET (Core), Databases en REST API’s;

+ Ervaring met complexe SaaS-architecturen;

+ Ervaring met MS SQL Databases, en performance tuning/troubleshooting op DB niveau;

+ Kennis van infrastructuur-principes en voldoende begrip van front-end aspecten om goed samen te werken en te beoordelen;

+ Ervaring met FluentMigrator, Aspose, en algemene testautomatisering is een pré;

+ Ervaring met low-code is een pré.

Ook breng je mee:

+ Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt complexe datastromen en neemt onderbouwde besluiten voor schaalbaarheid en security;

+ Communicatieve samenwerking: je zorgt voor een sterke verbinding binnen het multidisciplinaire team;

+ Eigenaarschap: je houdt overzicht, anticipeert op risico’s en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat;

+ Een proactieve houding: je neemt initiatief, en zorgt ervoor dat benodigde informatie actief opgehaald wordt zodat projecten vlot doorlopen.


Onze Whitevision manier van werken is met respect, daadkracht, betrokkenheid en ambitie.

Deze kernwaarden passen dan ook uitstekend bij jouw persoonlijkheid.



Dit verdien jij
+ Een salaris waar je blij van wordt, €5.500 - €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en flexibele werktijden.

+ Een mooi kantoor in Zoetermeer. We bieden ook de mogelijkheid om ook twee dagen per week thuis te werken, maar veel van onze collega’s vinden het zo leuk om op kantoor te werken dat zij dit minimaal doen.

+ Wij investeren graag in de groei en ontwikkeling van onze collega’s door middel van training of opleiding.

+ Een gezellig team met kantoren in Zoetermeer, de Goorn, Rotterdam en Breda. We werken hard, maar lachen minstens zo veel met elkaar!

+ Onderdeel worden van een snelgroeiend SaaS-bedrijf in Breda met de missie om repeterend werk de wereld uit te helpen.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. title: Global Senior Program Manager
description:

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. 

 

Your main responsibilities are: 

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. 

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. 

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. 

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. 

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. 

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. 

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. 

 

Why do you want this position? 

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. 

 

What do we offer? 

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for. 

At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success. 

In addition, we offer: 

  • A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background. 

  • revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary.  

  • Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days). 

  • Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business. 

  • Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. 

  • A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. 

 

Who are you?

Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results.  

 

Furthermore, we are looking for: 

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.  

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities.  

  • Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery.  

  • Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results.  

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel. 

 

If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch!

Samenwerking, continu verbeteren en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk. Dit is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Je bent een initiatiefrijke, ondernemende en zelfstandige productmanager die strategisch inzicht weet te combineren met technische basiskennis. Je begrijpt de technische uitdagingen van onze infrastructuurdiensten en kunt hierover effectief communiceren met zowel engineers als andere stakeholders.

Je kunt strategisch denken, relevante markttrends herkennen en deze vertalen naar een productvisie. Daarbij weet je verschillende belangen en behoeften met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt een sterke ambitie om de user- en customer experience maximaal te faciliteren. Continu samen verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Je ziet kansen om onze dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.
