Wil je bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige databasediensten binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie, maar zoek je bewust een functie voor 16 uur per week? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • analyseren en oplossen van complexe vraagstukken rondom MSSQL en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance, troubleshooting en database-optimalisatie;

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.


Je toekomstige collega's

Je komt te werken in Team Data & Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 IT-professionals die werkzaam zijn vanuit Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Team Data & Webdiensten bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega’s.

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

Daarnaast kun je jouw technische afwegingen helder uitleggen. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met andere technische disciplines, deelt je kennis en kunt collega’s adviseren zonder het werk van hen over te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren relevante ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en optimaliseren van databaseomgevingen;

  • aantoonbare en diepgaande ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance tuning, troubleshooting, back-up/restore en high availability;

  • ervaring met Windows- en Linux-serveromgevingen en automatisering met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Bash en/of Python;

  • kennis van databasebeveiliging, waaronder encryptie, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging en compliance;

  • kennis van Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD en DevOps-werkwijzen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Ansible;

  • kennis van ITIL-processen, sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding gericht op kennisdeling en continue verbetering.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Microsoft SQL Server en/of PostgreSQL zijn een pré.


Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

You should apply if:

  • You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.
  • You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.
  • You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.
  • You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.
  • You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.
  • You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.

In this role you will:

  • Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.
  • Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.
  • Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.
  • Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.
  • Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.
  • Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.

Advantageous:

  • Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.
  • Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.
  • Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.
  • Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

€132.000—€132.000 EUR

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

title: Accounts Payable & Financial Controller
description:
Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI.

Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar.

  • Je stuurt een team van werkstudenten en stagiaires aan en zorgt er samen met hen voor dat alle facturen tijdig en correct worden verwerkt.

  • Je ondersteunt bij de maandafsluiting, controleert grootboekrekeningen en helpt mee met ad-hoc analyses en periodieke rapportages.

  • Je denkt actief mee over het slim inrichten van financiële workflows. Je verkent en implementeert mogelijkheden voor procesautomatisering, slimme datakoppelingen en AI-oplossingen (zoals OCR-herkenning en geautomatiseerde factuurverwerking).

  • Je rapporteert aan de Lead Financial Controller, die je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse werkzaamheden en je helpt om door te groeien in je rol.

Dit ben jij

Als ideale kandidaat heb je al een basis aan kennis en ervaring en wil je blijven leren in een vakgebied dat continu verandert en digitaliseert. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy).

  • Je hebt 0-3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële of control-functie.

  • Je hebt ervaring met de crediteurenadministratie en het verwerken en controleren van facturen.

  • Kennis van accountingsoftware (zoals Exact) is een pré.

  • Je bent handig met data en hebt een sterke affiniteit met automatisering en nieuwe technologieën (zoals AI-tools, data-integraties en procesoptimalisatie).

  • Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

  • Je bent integer, nauwkeurig en risicobewust. Je begrijpt dat een strakke administratie de basis vormt voor goede besluitvorming.

  • Je denkt in kansen en mogelijkheden: je ziet direct waar processen sneller, slimmer of foutlozer kunnen en schroomt niet om dit op te pakken.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Audit Methodology Lead
description:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Interview with an Audit Expert

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and integrations with external systems (Postman, Playwright API testing or similar), including authentication flows like OAuth and webhooks

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong exploratory testing skills, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You’ve defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS, ideally with a public API or integration marketplace

  • Contract testing (e.g. Pact) or mocking third-party services

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change

  • Testing integrations with accounting or finance software

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

title: Product Manager

Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it.

I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself.

The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. title: Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems
description:
VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground. We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems.

About the Role



We are looking for a Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our team supporting activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany.

The position will support the CGSS project, an established operational project responsible for an application used to generate ground station pass schedules for EUMETSAT missions.

The successful candidate will contribute to the development, maintenance, verification and evolution of the application and will work closely with engineers, operational teams and end users.

This is a great opportunity for a professionals in applying their technical skills to operational satellite ground systems and mission planning.

What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:

  • Contributing to the development, maintenance and evolution of the CGSS application.
  • Developing and maintaining software components, with a particular focus on Python-based development.
  • Supporting the development and maintenance of web-based applications and interfaces.
  • Analysing software requirements and translating operational needs into technical solutions.
  • Performing software Verification & Validation (V&V) activities.
  • Preparing and executing functional, integration, regression and acceptance tests.
  • Investigating and troubleshooting software anomalies and supporting their resolution.
  • Supporting the integration and deployment of software releases.
  • Contributing to technical and user documentation.
  • Working directly with end users and operational stakeholders to understand requirements, collect feedback and support effective use of the system.
  • Contributing to the reliability and maintainability of software used within an operational space environment.
  • Working closely with other engineering teams involved in mission planning, ground station systems and satellite operations.


What We Look For



You do not need to fulfil every requirement below. We are looking for candidates who combine several of these skills and are motivated to develop further within the space operations domain.

Technical Experience

Ideally, you will bring experience in several of the following areas:

  • Software engineering and the software development lifecycle.
  • Python development.
  • Development of web-based applications.
  • Software Verification & Validation, testing and quality assurance.
  • Requirements analysis and software documentation.
  • Version control and collaborative development environments, preferably using tools such as Git/GitLab.
  • CI/CD, automated testing or software deployment processes.
  • Linux-based development or operational environments.


Space Domain Experience

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be highly desirable:

  • Satellite or spacecraft operations.
  • Mission Planning Systems or scheduling applications.
  • Ground segment software and operational systems.
  • Ground Station Monitoring and Control systems.
  • Ground station scheduling, pass planning or contact planning.
  • Integration of mission planning applications with other mission control or ground segment systems.
  • Working with operational teams or end users in a mission-critical environment.


Previous experience with EUMETSAT, ESA or comparable European space programmes would be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Relevant professional experience in a similar role is a plus.


Personal Skills



We're looking for someone who:

  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Enjoys working directly with technical and operational end users.
  • Can communicate effectively with both software engineers and operational stakeholders.
  • Takes a structured and reliable approach to development, testing and troubleshooting.
  • Can work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team.
  • Is curious and willing to learn about mission planning and satellite ground operations.
  • Has good attention to detail, particularly when working with operational software and verification activities.
  • Has English language proficiency at C1 level or above, both written and spoken.


Additional Requirements

  • Candidates must have the right to work in the European Union.
  • The role is expected to support activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, so candidates should be willing and able to work from Darmstadt according to the operational needs of the service.
  • Availability to start as early as possible in 2027, ideally during the first quarter of the year and preferably no later than April 2027.


Ready to join us?

If you are passionate about software engineering and would like to apply your skills to real-world satellite operations, we'd love to hear from you.

Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. A strong background in several of the areas above, combined with the willingness to learn, may be exactly what we're looking for.

Apply today!

Bei SEOMATIK lernst du, wie man attraktive Zielkunden identifiziert, Geschäftspotenziale erkennt, überzeugende Vertriebsstrategien entwickelt und daraus konkrete Kundenkontakte entstehen lässt.

description:

Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.

You'll have high autonomy. You choose the tools and the approach, including trialling new vendors and open-source solutions. Sign-off is needed in two cases. - You've worked in or closely with Finance: in a finance team, as a finance data partner, or in data work centred on treasury, reconciliation, accounting or FP&A.

- You have ETL and data warehouse or lakehouse experience, including onboarding sources end to end.
- You choose precision over speed when the two conflict.
- You work like a consultant to the business: you understand how a process works, propose solutions and frame them in terms of business value.

- Databricks and Unity Catalog

- Background in fintech, banking or payments

title: Telecom security trainer
description:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces.

Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub).

Job Description

Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions

We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide.

Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies.

This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives.

  • Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team.

  • Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery.

  • Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately.

  • Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues.

  • Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies.

  • Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks.

  • Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery.

  • Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery.

  • Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission.

Required qualifications

  • Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains:

  • SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security.

  • LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity.

  • GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope.

  • IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security.

  • 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course.

  • You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently.

  • Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams.

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience.

  • Practical experience analyzing telecom signaling traces and using packet-analysis tools such as Wireshark.

  • Confidence working with Linux-based lab environments and troubleshooting connectivity or exercise issues.

  • Professional preparation, reliable delivery, and clear communication with clients and the P1 Security team.

  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally for short-term onsite engagements: typically around five days per mission including travel, with some engagements requiring up to two weeks onsite.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in telecom security consulting, penetration testing, incident response, signaling monitoring, or mobile core network operations.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP security specifications and relevant GSMA signaling security guidance.

  • Experience with signaling firewalls, roaming and interconnect security, or telecom threat detection.

  • Experience adapting digital learning content into instructor-led courses and practical exercises.

  • Familiarity with virtualized or containerized lab environments and scripting for lab preparation.

  • Experience teaching international audiences or working across different cultural and organizational contexts.

Language requirements

  • Fluent professional English, with the ability to deliver technical instruction and facilitate discussions.

  • Additional languages are a plus, including French.

Engagement details

  • Contract type: Freelance, on a per-mission basis.

  • Delivery location: Onsite at client locations worldwide.

  • Mission duration: Typically around five days including travel; some engagements may require up to two weeks onsite.

  • Headquarters: Paris, France.

  • Training materials: Established curriculum and lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform, adapted for each classroom engagement.

  • Commercial arrangements: Scope, preparation time, delivery dates, fees, and travel and accommodation arrangements to be agreed for each mission.

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

  • C-level & Director call (30 min)

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

To apply, please send your CV or professional profile and a short introduction highlighting your telecom security expertise and training experience. Include the protocols and courses you can teach, examples of previous workshops or audiences, your availability, your location and travel flexibility, and your indicative daily rate. Please do not include confidential client information.

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

  • Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.

  • Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.

  • Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications

  • 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.

  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.

  • Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).

  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).

  • Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

  • Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

  • Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

  • Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

  • Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

  • You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

  • You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

  • A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

  • You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

  • You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

  • You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

  • You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

  • The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

  • Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

  • Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

  • A good pension plan

  • Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

  • Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day.

title: Senior Projectmanager
description:

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment

The assignment will include the following tasks:

  • A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

  • A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

  • Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

  • Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results

The final outcomes of this assignment will be:

§  A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.

§  An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.

§  A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration

For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

  • You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

  • You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

  • You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

  • You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

  • A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

  • Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

  • An internship allowance

  • Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

  • Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR

Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen.

Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt.

Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd.

  • Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging.

  • Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen.

  • Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken.

  • Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen.

  • Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment;

  • werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties;

  • werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team;

  • kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen;

  • heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré;

  • beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.


Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. 


What You'll Do

  • Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. 

  • Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. 

  • Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. 

  • Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

  • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. 

  • Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. 

  • Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. 

  • Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. 

  • Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. 


What You'll Need

Leadership & Product Team Experience 

  • A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. 

  • A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. 

  • A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. 

  • Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. 

  • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. 

  • Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. 

  • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. 

  • Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. 

Cartography & Digital Map Making 

  • A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. 

  • Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. 

  • Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. 

  • Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. 

  • Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. 

Map Visualisation & Rendering 

  • Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. 

  • Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. 

  • Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. 

  • Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. 

AI in Your Practice 

  • Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. 

  • Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. 

  • Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. 

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. 

  • Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. 

  • User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. 

  • High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. 


Nice to Have

  • Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. 

  • Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. 

  • Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar.

What we offer

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.

Suchst du einen Ausbildungsbetrieb, bei dem du nicht nur IT-Systeme, sondern auch dein Know-How auf das nächste Level hebst? Bei Maximal Dental in Bamberg wartet deine Chance, die Dentalbranche zu revolutionieren!

Aufgaben

title: Platform Engineer Open Source (m/w/d)
description:
Worum gehts?

Kurz: einen Generalisten für den ganzen Stack, der auch mal eine gewachsene Anwendung kubernetifiziert.

Du bist Teil unseres Teams und stehst im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kunden & Partnern. Wir wollen geile Projekte umsetzen – mit cooler Technologie, die dem Kunden wirklich hilft!

Deine Aufgaben!

Das machst du bei uns:

  • Anwendungen kubernetifizieren: Du nimmst Bestandsanwendungen auseinander, schreibst Dockerfiles und Helm Charts und bringst sie sauber auf Kubernetes – von der Java-Monolithen-Altlast bis zum frischen Microservice.

  • Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen: Aufbau von Kubernetes-Plattformen mit dem, was das CNCF-Ökosystem hergibt: Ingress-Controller, cert-manager, Harbor als Registry, Keycloak für Identity, Vault oder OpenBao für Secrets. Cloud-agnostisch, On-Premises oder hybrid.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform bzw. OpenTofu, Ansible, Helm und Kustomize – du automatisierst alles, was automatisiert werden kann, und gießt jede Komponente in versionierten Code.

  • CI/CD & GitOps: Aufbau und Optimierung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions. GitOps-Workflows mit ArgoCD oder Flux.

  • Security & Policies: Policies mit Kyverno oder OPA/Gatekeeper, Image-Scanning mit Trivy, Runtime-Security mit Falco. Du baust sichere Baselines ab Tag 1.

  • Observability: Aufbau von Monitoring-Stacks mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki und OpenTelemetry – du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden wissen, was auf ihrer Plattform passiert. Mit OpenCost auch, was sie kostet.

  • Backup, Recovery & Lifecycle: Backup- und Restore-Konzepte mit Velero, Cluster- und Komponenten-Upgrades, Lifecycle-Management. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Plattform nicht nur läuft, sondern auch wiederherstellbar und wartbar bleibt – als Code, nicht per Klick.

  • Kundenberatung & Befähigung: Du arbeitest embedded in Kundenteams, nimmst an Standups teil und befähigst Teams, ihre Plattform selbstständig zu betreiben.

Projektbeispiele aus unserem Alltag:

  • Containerisierung gewachsener Java-Anwendungen und Umzug auf Kubernetes für ein Finanzunternehmen

  • On-Premises-Kubernetes-Plattform mit Harbor, Keycloak und ArgoCD für ein Industrieunternehmen

  • Migration von VM-basierten Workloads auf Kubernetes mit Helm und GitLab CI für ein E-Commerce-Unternehmen

  • Secrets-Management mit Vault und Policy-as-Code mit Kyverno für ein Versicherungsunternehmen

  • Observability-Stack mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki und OpenTelemetry für ein Healthcare-Unternehmen

  • Backup- und Restore-Konzept mit Velero für ein Logistikunternehmen



Dein Profil

Must-have (ohne das wird's schwer):

  • Linux & Container: Solide Linux-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Docker bzw. Containern – du weißt, was im Container passiert und warum.

  • Kubernetes: Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, egal ob Vanilla, in der Cloud oder On-Premises.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Erfahrung mit Terraform/OpenTofu oder Ansible sowie Helm und/oder Kustomize.

  • CI/CD: Erfahrung mit mindestens einem CI/CD-Tool (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) für automatisierte Deployments.

  • Networking: Verständnis von DNS, TLS, Load Balancing und Container-Networking.

Nice-to-have (macht dich noch interessanter):

  • GitOps: Erfahrung mit ArgoCD oder Flux.

  • Security: Erfahrung mit Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, Trivy, Falco oder Vault.

  • Observability: Erfahrung mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki oder OpenTelemetry.

  • Identity & Registry: Erfahrung mit Keycloak und Harbor.

  • Cloud-Provider: Erste Erfahrung mit AWS oder Azure schadet nicht – ist aber kein Muss.

  • Zertifizierungen: CKA, CKAD, CKS, LFCS oder andere CNCF-Zertifizierungen.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne embedded in Kundenteams und bist ein Teamplayer.

  • Lernbereitschaft: Du bleibst am Ball und lernst kontinuierlich neue Technologien.

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips.   • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Track open invoices and prepare payment runs

  • Align with suppliers and external partners on payments, open items and payment terms

  • Process employee expense claims and reimbursements, ensuring receipts and approvals are complete
