title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product role with real scope: you won't be handed a corner of a system, you'll own complete product slices end-to-end, from spec through to something live that customers depend on every day. Here's a taste of what that looks like in practice:

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. Built with Monzo as the design partner. Public on the Chrome Web Store.

  • A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, the action runs. Not chat over a database.

  • The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

  • An integration surface that reaches into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com, Frame.io for video.

  • A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

You think in user outcomes and shipped work, not tickets closed. Your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day, and they'll tell you fast when something's wrong, which is exactly the kind of feedback loop that makes this job good.

What you'll do

  • Own product delivery. Take features from spec to production, frontend-first but covering backend and integration where needed.

  • Build the product surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, the moments where model output meets human judgement.

  • Work with AI in the critical path. Ship features where the model is genuinely part of the product, not a bolted-on feature.

  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. We deploy continuously, so you'll feel the pace immediately.

  • Have real input on what we build, how we build it, and which problems are worth solving next. Nobody here is precious about a roadmap someone else wrote.

What we're looking for

  • Independent delivery. You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision. Your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and solved real user problems.

  • Product trade-off judgement. You balance speed, quality and user impact under ambiguity. You push back when something is underspecified, and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship anyway.

  • Product taste. You notice when something feels wrong and aren't afraid to raise it. You care about the smaller details while still knowing when to ship at pace.

  • Cross-functional pragmatism. You work effectively with founders, designers and AI engineers, and you unblock yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

  • AI literacy. You're fluent with modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents). You treat them as collaborators, know when to trust them and when to override them, and have real opinions about where they help and where they get in the way.

Strong technical depth in:

  • Strong TypeScript and React. Comfortable end-to-end.

  • Building products where AI is in the critical path.

  • Modern web tooling. Node, Postgres.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono, or Drizzle.

  • Experience in regulated industries: fintech, healthtech, legaltech.

The Stack

React and TypeScript on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer.

How we work

  • Location in London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day.

  • You talk to customers, you input your expertise on the strategy and execute it with our vision in mind

  • You own what you ship, including after it's shipped.

You’ll lead the strategy across VIP partnerships, Influencers, Ambassadors, Pro, PR, gifting and events, turning TALA into a brand that people see, talk about and want to be part of.

You’ll know and understand that the fastest way to build awareness is to put TALA in the right hands, in the right places, with the right people.

The successful candidate will bring a serious black book of relevant VIPs from celebrities and musicians to stylists, athletes, creators and cultural tastemakers and know how to build genuine relationships with them.

  • Continuously assess and evolve the programmes based on KPIs including brand impact, reach, engagement and commercial contribution.

Influencer

  • Set the direction for the talent TALA works with, from high-profile creators and cultural tastemakers to emerging talent and community voices.

Gifting

  • Own the strategic direction for TALA gifting, transforming it from a reactive PR function into a significant awareness and brand-building engine.
  • Together with the team, define who TALA should be gifting, when, why and what we want gifting to achieve.
  • Oversee the strategy for key product launches, cultural moments, VIP gifting, stylist seeding and wider brand moments.
  • Lead the team in developing, signing off and executing gifting programmes, ensuring activity ladders back to wider brand and campaign priorities.

PR

  • Together with the Brand Marketing Director own the overall PR strategy and communications agenda for TALA.
  • Define the role of PR within the wider brand strategy and how it will contribute to building fame, credibility and awareness.
  • Set the annual PR strategy, priorities, narratives and key cultural moments, working closely with Brand Marketing, Social, Influencer and Product.
  • Brief the PR agency to establish the types of stories TALA should be known for and proactively identify opportunities to create news rather than simply respond to it.
  • Ensure the PR team and agency has a clear roadmap and empower them to execute against it.

Events & Experiences

  • Own the TALA events and experiences strategy, defining how physical brand experiences can drive awareness, desirability, community and growth.
  • Set the annual events strategy, including the role of VIP events, consumer experiences, cultural moments, product launches, retail activations and larger-scale brand moments.
  • Define what makes a TALA experience distinctive and ensure every activation is rooted in the brand and designed to generate impact beyond the room.
  • Identify and feed into the events team opportunities for TALA to create culturally relevant moments that can extend into PR, social and organic conversation.
  • Oversee the brief and objectives for key events, with the team responsible for planning and delivering the experience.
  • Oversee the evaluation of the effectiveness of events against awareness, reach, brand impact and commercial objectives, continually evolving the approach.

Requirements

About You

We’re looking for someone who is highly connected, culturally switched-on and relentlessly ambitious.

You will likely have:

  • Significant experience across VIP, celebrity, influencers, PR and events within fashion, beauty, lifestyle or a culturally relevant consumer brand.
  • A strong existing network of VIPs, stylists, agents, managers, media and cultural tastemakers.
  • A proven ability to build authentic relationships with high-profile talent.
  • Experience creating campaigns and moments that generate significant awareness and organic conversation.
  • Strong commercial and strategic thinking, understanding that awareness must ultimately contribute to brand and business growth.
  • A strong understanding of culture, fashion, music, TV, sport, entertainment and what makes people talk.
  • An instinct for what feels cool, relevant and TALA.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and negotiation skills.
  • The confidence to challenge the status quo and create ideas that haven't been done before.
  • A highly proactive, entrepreneurial approach, you’ll spot opportunities rather than wait for a brief.
  • The ability to operate at both strategic and executional level, from defining the annual VIP strategy to picking up the phone to a stylist.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • TALA is increasingly seen on the right people.
  • We have a strong and growing network of A-list and culturally relevant VIPs who genuinely want to wear and engage with TALA.
  • TALA becomes a brand that celebrities, stylists and cultural tastemakers actively want to be associated with.
  • Our Ambassador and Pro programmes become recognised as some of the most exciting programmes in the category.
  • Gifting creates genuine organic reach, conversation and product desire.
  • Our events become moments people want to attend and talk about.
  • TALA earns more high-quality PR and cultural coverage.
  • We create moments that travel across social, PR and culture, delivering awareness well beyond the original activation.
  • Most importantly, you help move TALA from a brand people discover on social media to a brand people know, recognise and want.

Benefits

  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

 

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

title: Founding Enterprise BDR | France
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. The product is real; the French playbook is still being written. We are outsiders here, and we will earn our place through better conversations, sharper execution, and customers who see the difference.

We are outbound first. As our founding BDR in France, you will start conversations rather than wait for them. You will find the right companies, reach the people who own customer operations, and create qualified opportunities for the team. You will also help decide which messages, channels, and routines deserve to become our French sales playbook.

What you'll do

  • Build targeted account lists and find the people with a real customer interaction problem to solve.

  • Prospect every day through calls, email, LinkedIn, and thoughtful experiments. The phone is a core part of this role.

  • Run sharp first conversations: understand the workflow, volume, owner, urgency, and reason to act; then hand over opportunities with context the AE can use.

  • Test messages and sequences, measure what turns into useful conversations and qualified pipeline, and improve quickly.

  • Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging.

What makes you a great fit

  • You do not need sales experience. Your background could be the military, firefighting, competitive sport, or something else entirely. What matters is your discipline, coachability, rigor, and ability to keep going through rejection.

  • You speak clearly, listen closely, are curious about how businesses work, and are willing to learn a technical product. You are comfortable picking up the phone.

  • You care about the quality of the opportunity, not just the number of meetings on a calendar.

  • You take feedback directly, own your results, and keep moving when the answer is no.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You speak and write excellent French, work comfortably in English, are based in Paris, and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You need inbound leads, a finished script, or detailed direction before you can start.

  • You avoid the phone or repeated outreach.

  • You resist coaching or let a string of no's stop you from trying a better approach.

  • You value meeting counts over understanding whether a prospect has a real problem and reason to act.

The reality of the role

You will be one of the first people building telli's presence in France. There is no mature local demand engine or perfect script to inherit. Outbound is the core of this role, and some ideas will fail. You will make a lot of calls, learn fast, and help turn an early market into a repeatable business. If that sounds like the best challenge of your career, we want to meet you.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you open doors. Show us how you prepare, earn a first conversation, ask and listen, follow up, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the discipline and judgment you would bring to building pipeline in France.

title: Senior Data Consultant
AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech
description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech

Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.

We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.

Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.

Why this role, why now

AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.

Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.

The mission

We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective:

  • Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today.

  • Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.

Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:

80%: deploy AI inside our ventures

Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved.

  • Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks.

  • Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides.

  • Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring.

  • Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once.

20%: studio radar and partnerships

  • Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing.

  • See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not.

  • Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone.

  • Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one.

  • Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue.

Who we’re looking for

  • An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers.

  • 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents.

  • A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one.

  • High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week.

  • Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures.

  • Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams.

Recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner at Hexa

  • Interview with Guerric: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. Propose an AI-augmented workflow and run it as a short hands-on workshop with the founders, with at least one tool working live

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO)

  • Coffee with team members & Reference checks

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle

title: Talent Sourcer (gn) / Recruiter (gn) - 100% REMOTE
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Eine Führungskraft mit zehn Jahren Bauerfahrung schreibt keine Bewerbungen. Sie steht auf der Baustelle. Die meisten schicken ihr eine Nachricht und warten. Du fasst nach, greifst zum Telefon und holst sie ins Gespräch. Wenn das nach dir klingt, lies weiter.

JIRO ist eine Personalberatung für Bau und Infrastruktur mit Kunden in ganz Europa. Wir besetzen anspruchsvolle Führungspositionen, die lange offen bleiben. Für diese Suche bauen wir ein Sourcing-Team aus Leuten auf, denen Durchschnitt nicht reicht.

Arbeite, wann du willst. Wo du willst. So viel du willst.

Dein Job in vier Schritten

  • Finden. Auf den gängigen Portalen und in Netzwerken suchst du die Profile, die zu unseren Stellen passen. Zu jeder Stelle bekommst du ein Briefing.
  • Ansprechen. Du schreibst Nachrichten, die nach Mensch klingen, nicht nach Vorlage oder KI.
  • Dranbleiben. Bleibt die Antwort aus, hakst du nach. Zeigt jemand Interesse, greifst du zum Telefon. Du bleibst am Ball, bis aus einem Vielleicht ein Termin wird.
  • Termin legen. Das Erstgespräch buchst du direkt im Kalender deines Kollegen. Ab da übernimmt er.

Vertrieb, Kundentermine und CRM-Pflege gehören nicht zu deinem Job. Deine ganze Energie geht ins Sourcing.

Wann, wo und wie viel: Du entscheidest

Wann du willst. Early Bird oder Nachteule, deine Entscheidung. Uns interessiert, was du lieferst, nicht ob dein Teams-Status grün ist.

Wo du willst. Du arbeitest zu 100 % remote. Lust auf ein paar Wochen Dubai, Lissabon oder Catania? Workation ist bei uns gern gesehen. Einzige Regel: Telefoniert wird, wenn Europa wach ist.

So viel du willst. Wie viel du rausholst, entscheidest du selbst.

Dein Verdienst hat keinen Deckel

Deine Vergütung setzt sich aus vier Teilen zusammen:

  • eine feste Basis
  • eine Provision für jedes Gespräch, das du legst
  • eine Provision für jede Einstellung, die daraus entsteht
  • Extra-Boni, die wir spontan ausloben, etwa für geknackte Ziele oder brennende Stellen

Was du außerdem bekommst

  • Jeden Tag gemeinsam besser. Wir treffen uns täglich als Team. Was hat funktioniert, was nicht, was machen wir morgen anders? Wir wachsen zusammen, nicht jeder für sich.
  • Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Wir sagen dir offen, was gut lief und wo noch Luft ist. Ehrlich, direkt, ohne Watte.
  • Stillstand gibt’s nicht. Suche, Ansprache, Nachfassen: Wir testen, messen und schärfen nach. Was besser funktioniert, wird Standard für dich und das ganze Team.
  • Aufstieg für alle, die Bock haben. Sourcing ist bei uns keine Sackgasse. Wer mehr will und das zeigt, wächst in die nächste Rolle.
  • Kleines Team, kurze Wege. Schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Corporate-Blabla, kein „Dafür bin ich nicht zuständig”.
  • Die Werkzeuge zahlen wir. Profi-Zugänge zu den gängigen Portalen gehen auf uns.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du kannst mit Menschen. Ob aus Recruiting, Vertrieb, Promotion oder Einzelhandel: Du weißt, wie man Fremde in wenigen Sätzen für sich gewinnt. Recruiting-Erfahrung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung.
  • Du schreibst kurz und persönlich, ohne Floskeln.
  • Hängt eine Suche fest, gibst du nicht auf, sondern probierst den nächsten Weg.
  • Rankings spornen dich an, und du willst ganz oben stehen.
  • Du ziehst durch, auch wenn niemand daneben sitzt.
  • Was du zusagst, hältst du.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst sicheres Deutsch.
  • Pluspunkte: Erfahrung mit Recruiting-Portalen oder mit dem Bau.

Nichts für dich, wenn …

  • … es dir egal ist, ob du einen Termin mehr oder weniger legst.
  • … du lieber Kunden betreust und Abschlüsse machst. Dafür gibt es unsere Stelle als Recruitment Consultant (360°).
  • … du jemanden brauchst, der dir morgens die To-do-Liste schreibt.

So geht’s weiter

  • Kennenlern-Call: Wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen, und wir legen dir die Zahlen zu deinem Verdienst offen.
  • Short Case: Du bekommst eine echte offene Stelle, findest passende Profile und schreibst eine Ansprache. Kein halber Arbeitstag. Wer mehr liefert als verlangt, fällt uns auf.
  • Start: Zugänge, Briefing, los.

Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil reicht für den ersten Schritt.

We’re hiring a Founding Sales Leader in EMEA to build our business in the region from the ground up. We already have EMEA customers and real demand — today it’s served from the US. You’ll be our first person on the ground in London, and your job is to localize that business and turn it into a region.

This is a founding-leader role, not inheriting a machine. You’ll be in deals directly while making your first hires, with a mandate to scale the EMEA team to 20+ people this year across front-line leaders and sellers.

The right person for this role is a player-coach who has managed managers, sold to technical buyers, and hired quickly — and who wants to run a region before a bigger company would hand them one. If you’re energized by ambiguity, an unformed market, and building with what’s in front of you, this is one of the most consequential GTM roles at Baseten.

  • Own EMEA: all segments, all markets, top to bottom.

  • Build the team. Recruit, hire, and onboard 20+ people this year, including the front-line leaders who will run it with you.

  • Carry the number. Build pipeline, run deals, and close business yourself while the team is coming together.

  • Establish our presence in the region — the London footprint, our reputation with EMEA buyers, and the local playbook for how enterprise buying works here.

  • Adapt the motion. Take what works in AMER and tune it to how technical buyers in EMEA actually evaluate and purchase infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with a US-based org across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Solutions, and Recruiting, with significant US timezone overlap.

  • Set the bar for execution, forecasting rigor, and speed as the region scales.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A proven hiring track record. You’ve built teams quickly and hired leaders, not just ICs, and you can point to the people you’ve developed.

  • Second-line leadership experience. You’ve managed managers and owned a multi-team org.

  • Enterprise selling experience against a technical line of business. You can hold your own with engineering and infrastructure buyers and want to go deeper on inference.

  • Scrappiness. You’re comfortable being the only Baseten person in the region on day one — building pipeline, closing deals, and recruiting at the same time, without the bells and whistles.

  • EMEA fluency. You know the regional markets and how enterprise buying differs from the US.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, high-intensity environment. Here, that means you Slack faster than you talk.

  • A builder’s mentality. You own problems and their solutions, and you’re at your best in high-change, unstructured environments.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Engineering Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.

You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.

This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization.

What You'll Do:

People Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, feedback, and career development.

  • Build a supportive, high-performing team environment where engineers have clear expectations, opportunities to grow, and the autonomy to do their best work.

  • Take ownership of team health, engagement, and retention, proactively identifying and addressing challenges.

Hiring & Team Growth

  • Own the engineering side of hiring for your squads, including defining requirements, setting assessment criteria, interviewing, and making hiring decisions.

  • Develop effective onboarding processes that help new engineers become productive and autonomous quickly.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to shape team structure, squad ownership, and hiring priorities as the organization scales.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Partner with Product Managers to translate product and business priorities into clear engineering objectives, realistic roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Own engineering delivery across your squads, ensuring work is appropriately scoped, estimated, and delivered with clear accountability.

  • Identify and manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and competing priorities, keeping stakeholders informed and addressing blockers early.

Engineering Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and continuously improve how your squads operate, using our Discovery → Run lifecycle, inspired by Shape Up, and DORA metrics to measure delivery effectiveness.

  • Establish practical, scalable ways of working that improve predictability, collaboration, and engineering quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and the VP of Engineering to evaluate and improve engineering processes across the wider organization.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance on architectural decisions, engineering trade-offs, and complex delivery challenges, ensuring teams make well-informed decisions.

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Support, Sales, and leadership to align engineering priorities with business needs.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly, creating transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built in Go (Golang), with Svelte on the frontend, PostgreSQL and OpenSearch for data, and DigitalOcean for cloud infrastructure. We use Docker, GitHub Actions, and Grafana to support deployment, automation, and observability, with a modular hexagonal monolith architecture.

You won't need to be hands-on with every technology, but you'll bring the technical understanding to challenge architectural decisions, navigate trade-offs, and support your engineers in solving complex problems.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've built a strong understanding of our product, technology, engineering processes, and business objectives, establishing trusted relationships with your engineers and key stakeholders.

  • You've taken ownership of people management across your squads, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and an understanding of each engineer's strengths and development needs.

  • You've assessed current delivery practices, team structure, and performance, identifying opportunities to improve collaboration, predictability, and team effectiveness.

By 6 months

  • Your squads are operating with clear objectives, defined ownership, and measurable KPIs aligned with product and business priorities.

  • You've established effective delivery practices, with more predictable planning, proactive risk management, and improved visibility for stakeholders.

  • You've identified team capability gaps and are actively contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the development of engineers across your squads.

  • You're contributing meaningful improvements to engineering processes and organizational structure alongside the wider engineering management team.

By 12 months

  • Your squads consistently deliver against realistic, well-defined roadmaps, with clear accountability, effective collaboration, and measurable improvements in delivery performance.

  • Engineers have clear development paths, receive regular feedback, and feel supported in their growth, contributing to strong engagement and retention.

  • New engineers are onboarding efficiently and becoming productive quickly, supported by established processes and a clear engineering hiring bar.

  • You've helped shape a scalable engineering organization with well-defined squad ownership, effective ways of working, and stronger alignment between Engineering, Product, and the wider business.

  • Stakeholders have confidence in engineering delivery, with transparent communication, reliable planning, and fewer unexpected blockers.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience directly managing and developing software engineers, ideally eight or more across multiple teams, within a growing engineering organization.

  • Demonstrated experience building or scaling engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and supporting engineers' career development.

  • A strong software engineering background with solid architectural fundamentals, enabling you to challenge technical decisions, understand trade-offs, and provide credible guidance.

  • Experience owning engineering delivery, translating product and business objectives into actionable plans, managing dependencies, and driving measurable outcomes.

  • A data-driven approach to engineering management, with experience using delivery metrics and team performance insights to identify and implement improvements.

  • The ability to establish effective engineering processes and ways of working that improve team performance without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the confidence to create structure, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions in a scaling environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience collaborating effectively across distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with Go (Golang) or managing teams building Go-based applications.

  • Familiarity with Shape Up or similar appetite-driven development methodologies.

  • Experience using DORA metrics to measure and improve engineering delivery.

  • Knowledge of Team Topologies and experience shaping squad structures as engineering teams scale.

  • Experience scaling an engineering organization from approximately 10 to 25 engineers.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, data-intensive products, or API-first platforms.

The Hiring Process:

  • Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 mins) - A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins) - A chance for you to meet our VP of Engineering and walk through your background, the teams you've led, what you've built and broken along the way.

  • Engineering management case study (60 mins) - A practical session grounded in a real situation: a hiring decision, a delivery slipping, a process that isn't being followed, a performance conversation.

  • Final Interview with our CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben and have a conversation around FullEnrich's ambitions, how we work and what we're building together.

Benefits:

Your benefits package will reflect the requirements and market practices of the country in which you're employed, including applicable leave, healthcare, retirement and wellbeing benefits.

Full details will be shared during the hiring process.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is creating Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a subsidiary seeking ACPR authorisation as a payment institution and financing company, to serve its 1.6 million SMB customers base.

  1. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will lay the foundations of PFS’s accounting model, controls and reporting as the business is built.

  2. You ensure the reliability of PFS’s financial information, from product events and accounting entries through to financial and prudential reporting.

  3. You check daily that client funds are safeguarded and that PFS meets its own funds requirements and applicable prudential ratios. You flag risks early and help the Head of Finance anticipate capital needs.

You report to Maxime Leclercq, GM PFS, and functionally to @Raphaël Nahum, Head of Finance, on accounting standards and methods aligned with group finance.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
description:

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

  • A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

description:
About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you'll be up to

  • Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.
  • Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.
  • Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.
  • Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.
  • Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.
  • Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.
  • Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you'll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

  • Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.
  • Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.
  • Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.
  • Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.
  • Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.
  • An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

  • Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.
  • Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.
  • Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

Culture and growth

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible.

title: Regional Operations Director-Based in Munich/Berlin
description:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers. 

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.
  • You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.
  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.
  • You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.
  • You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.
  • You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.
  • You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.
  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

  • Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.
  • A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.
  • Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.
  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

title: Global Investigator (EMEA)
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet

  • Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients.
