Our data flows from our applications, product events and business systems, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to build the platform that makes sure that data arrives complete, on time and safe to use, so Product, leadership, RevOps and Finance work from the same numbers.

You will be the first data engineer in a new data team that sits in Product, works across the company and reports to the Head of Data. You will own the platform that moves our data into Snowflake and shape the architecture decisions around it: which tools we build on, how pipelines are orchestrated and monitored, and how data infrastructure is managed as code.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work gives the teams serving hospitals and aftercare providers data they can trust.

  • Real ownership – as the first data engineer in a new team, you shape the data platform and its tooling.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Data from our application databases, product events and SaaS tools needs to reach Snowflake reliably. You build and run that ingestion and decide where to buy a managed connector and where to build.

  • Our pipelines need clear dependencies, retries, alerting and SLAs. You set up orchestration so a failed or partial load stops downstream work instead of silently producing wrong numbers.

  • New products need event pipelines. You design them together with engineers, keeping patient data out of analytics events by design.

  • Product and Finance need to work from the same definitions. You maintain the dbt models that connect product usage with customer, billing and revenue data.

  • Our CRM (HubSpot) and our internal systems need to talk to each other. You build the data flows between them, including two-way synchronisation where it is needed.

  • Data quality problems need to be caught before a dashboard or a board report does. You establish validation, monitoring and alerting.

  • Our data needs strong privacy and access controls. You enforce role-based access and masking in Snowflake, pseudonymisation, and deletion that propagates across raw and modelled data.

  • Data code needs the same engineering standards as our product code. You bring code review, testing, documentation and CI/CD to it.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to move, model and protect data reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes (EKS) and Postgres (RDS)

  • Warehouse and modelling: Snowflake (EU), dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow or Dagster (being introduced)

  • BI: Looker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Infrastructure: CloudFormation

  • Business systems: HubSpot, Chargebee


  • Several years (typically 5 or more) building production data pipelines, as a data engineer or as a backend engineer on data-intensive systems.

  • Strong Python: you write tested, maintainable production code, not only scripts.

  • Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs and query optimisation.

  • Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse: compute sizing and cost control, role-based access, masking, and performance tuning.

  • Experience with dbt, or a similar tool for tested and documented transformations.

  • Solid ingestion fundamentals: initial versus incremental loads, change data capture from Postgres, idempotency, schema evolution, late and out-of-order data, and backfills.

  • Production experience with an orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster.

  • Experience with AWS and with deploying your own work in containers.

  • A data quality mindset: you profile data, test assumptions and build checks.

  • Practical knowledge of GDPR: you can identify personal data and implement pseudonymisation, access control and deletion.

  • You use AI coding tools in your daily work and know where they help and where they need checking.

  • Ability to own decisions as the only data engineer and to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Other languages are a plus.

Bonus points

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Integrating CRM and SaaS systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including reverse ETL or two-way sync.

  • Designing product event tracking (e.g. Snowplow or Segment).

  • Kubernetes in production.

  • Reading and changing Go code.

  • Managing Snowflake as code.

  • German language skills.

Our values

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

title: Head of Strategy & Operations
description:
About remove

remove is a non-profit organisation with a mission to enable innovators globally to realize the "net" in net zero. remove has established premier global startup accelerator programs focused solely on Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) across Europe, India, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. To date, we have supported over 200 startups and cultivated a global CDR community. We also develop CDR ecosystems and engage in strategic projects to close systemic gaps in carbon removal globally. We are a small, remote team that works like a startup: high standards, an agile approach and a lot of ownership per person. Our work is funded by leading climate foundations and philanthropic partners such as The Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment, Postcode Loterij Fonds and VP Capital.

About the role

We are looking for a senior professional to lead strategy and operations at remove, managing our talent and running the engine that keeps us moving. You will work very closely with our two co-founders, manage our program managers, and be the person who makes sure the right things get done, well and on time, as we grow our impact in new ways and into new regions at a pivotal stage of our organization.

What you will own

Strategy

  • Lead strategic thinking, be a sounding board to the co-founders, and the person who "writes the strategy down" and plans for its execution.

  • Prepare and run strategy days, offsites and team meetups.

  • Own key strategic documents and shape important external documents.

Planning and Operations

  • Develop and own our roadmap and workplans. Keep everyone accountable to shared goals and spot early and proactively when plans need to change.

  • Own our operating rhythm: recurring meetings, brainstorms, 1:1s, team updates, retros and milestone planning.

  • Develop and improve the processes and documentation the team relies on, including program SOPs and team policies.

People and team

  • Line-manage our program managers: debottleneck daily operations, set priorities, manage workload, coach the team, manage development plans, etc.

  • Lead hiring and onboarding for new team members and external support, and plan team capacity as we grow. We are not expecting to grow team members in large numbers; we intend to remain a lean and mighty team.

  • Look after team health and ways of working in a fully remote, multicultural team.

Fundraising operations

  • Run the process behind the co-founders’ fundraising efforts.

  • Maintain and develop core materials such as our decks, concept notes and one-pagers, and draft or coordinate grant applications.

  • Own impact reporting content and contribute to funder reports.

Strategic projects & programs

  • Scope & lead strategic initiatives from idea to delivery, alongside recurring work.

  • Oversee our programs and systems as we expand.

  • Oversee our entity’s brand and communications.

Who you are

You must have

  • 12+ years of experience, including roles where you ran strategy, operations and/or a PMO for a leadership team. You have done this job before with a laser focus on high standards and timely execution. You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

  • Experience supporting fundraising or business development, e.g. pipelines, proposals and reporting.

  • A track record of managing people well, ideally in small remote teams.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can build structure where there is none and adjust it as things change.

  • Resourcefulness and agency. You see what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked, including the unglamorous parts. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and drive in conceptualising and executing initiatives, with strong organisational and documentation skills.

  • Excellent communication, writing and synthesis. You can turn a messy conversation into a clear plan, deck or proposal.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade diverse groups, in a cross-cultural remote setting.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote workspace, meeting deadlines and managing several work streams simultaneously.

  • Adaptability, curiosity and eagerness to keep learning in a dynamic environment.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Willingness to travel locally or occasionally regionally/globally, if necessary.

It is a plus if you have

  • A university degree (MSc. preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. environmental science, engineering, sustainability, business administration)

  • Experience in and a strong passion for climate action, carbon removal or the wider sustainability field.

  • Experience with accelerators, startups or entrepreneurship programs.

  • Experience with foundations or philanthropic funding.

  • Experience working in or with partners in the Global South.

  • A coaching or facilitation background.

Practicalities

  • This role reports to the two co-founders.

  • Location: remote, in Europe. Preference will be given to those based in Northwestern Europe due to proximity to the co-founders. Occasional travel for team meetups and selected events.

  • Contract: full time, with start date April 1, 2027. Depending on your location, you may be employed through an employer-of-record provider. You must be able to work in your country of residence. We will not sponsor visas or work permits.

  • Salary: competitive for non-profit salary bands for small teams in your location.

What we offer

  • A flexible and remote-first workplace.

  • An impact-driven role as part of a mission-driven team and organisation working with entrepreneurs globally.

  • A unique opportunity to experience and shape strategy for a future billion-dollar industry in its early days.

  • Exposure to a great network and community of CDR innovators and experts.

  • A learning budget to develop yourself.

  • Flexible holidays and biannual team off-sites.

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter (no more than one page) detailing your relevant experience and why you believe you would be the ideal candidate for the role. We will review applications on a rolling basis and aim to start interviews as soon as possible, latest by mid November 2026.

Our process:

  • First step after screening: Role-related interview with Rawan Gebran (Senior Director @ remove) - ~45 min

  • Next: Interview panel with both co-founders, Hans Westerhof & Marian Krueger - ~45 min

  • Then: 1:1 interviews with each of the founders individually - ~45 min each

  • Finally: Shortlisted candidates will be asked for 3 references willing to speak about their experience with you, professionally and in that time could meet the rest of the team.

If you’ve built and run the strategic and operating backbone for a small and agile team before and want to do it for the organization helping CDR startups globally get off the ground, we want to hear from you! We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

ITM Power ist ein führendes Unternehmen in der Branche für grünen Wasserstoff und entwickelt und fertigt hochmoderne PEM-Elektrolyseure, die eine Schlüsselrolle bei der weltweiten Dekarbonisierung spielen. Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten wissenschaftlicher Expertise haben wir uns als Branchenführer im Bereich der sauberen Energietechnologie etabliert.

Unsere Standorte in Deutschland dienen als zentrale Drehscheibe innerhalb der EU und beherbergen Teams aus den Bereichen Geschäftsentwicklung, Engineering, Beschaffung und Kundendienst, um unseren Kunden schnelle und effiziente Lösungen zu bieten.

ITM Power befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und konzentriert sich auf die effiziente Umsetzung von Projekten. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die unsere Leidenschaft für saubere Energie teilen und aktiv zur globalen Energiewende beitragen möchten.

Der Projektcontroller ist für die Verwaltung des Gesamtprojektzeitplans und die Kontrolle der Projektkosten verantwortlich und stellt sicher, dass die Ausgaben im Rahmen des Projektbudgets bleiben. Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören die Erstellung von Kostenberichten, die Analyse der finanziellen Leistung im Zusammenhang mit dem Projektplan sowie die Beratung von Projektmanagern und Stakeholdern hinsichtlich Strategien zum Kostenmanagement. Der Projektcontroller arbeitet eng mit den Finanz- und Projektmanagement-Teams zusammen, um eine genaue Kostenverfolgung und Berichterstattung sicherzustellen.

Sie unterstützen Projekte, indem Sie an internen und externen Kosten- und Terminüberprüfungen teilnehmen sowie die Kostenverfolgung und -abstimmung durchführen. Darüber hinaus führt diese Position regelmäßige Überprüfungen und Aktualisierungen des Projektrisikoregisters durch. Sie koordinieren die gesamten Projektsteuerungsaktivitäten unabhängig von Umfang und Komplexität, einschließlich Turnkey- und Pauschalprojekten, unter vollständiger Einhaltung der vertraglichen Anforderungen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam an der Entwicklung von Projektsteuerungsstrategien und -plänen, die mit den Projektzielen und vertraglichen Anforderungen übereinstimmen

  • In dieser Position überwachen, analysieren und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Kostenentwicklung und bestehende Projektrisiken, gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanager entwickeln Sie Maßnahmen, um kritische Bereiche anzugehen und die Projektziele zu erreichen

  • Sie stellen die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der Projektsteuerungsdaten und -informationen sicher und implementieren Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um zuverlässige und einheitliche Projektergebnisse zu gewährleisten

  • Sie entwickeln und pflegen Projektzeitpläne und arbeiten mit den Projektteammitgliedern zusammen, um wichtige Projektmeilensteine zu identifizieren und kritische Pfade zu analysieren

  • Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Projektkosten im Vergleich zum Budget und zur Prognose, erstellen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanagern Kostenschätzungen, identifizieren Kostenabweichungen und entwickeln entsprechende Korrekturmaßnahmen

  • Sie steuern die Prozesse zum Änderungsmanagement (Change Orders), um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert und in die Projektpläne sowie Kostenschätzungen integriert werden

  • Sie überwachen und überprüfen den Verbrauch von Arbeitsstunden im Verhältnis zu den erbrachten Leistungen und identifizieren Änderungen, die sich auf das erforderliche Budget auswirken

  • Sie identifizieren terminliche Herausforderungen und Probleme, die sich aus Einschränkungen oder Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Funktionen ergeben

  • Sie überwachen und berichten über den kritischen Pfad sowie die Terminplanentwicklung des Gesamtprojekts

  • Sie empfehlen dem Projektteam alternative Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung des Terminplans und bringen diese zur Diskussion bzw. Entscheidungsfindung ein

Das bringen Sie mit

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Kosteningenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Kostencontrolling oder in der Projektsteuerung innerhalb der Engineering- und Bauindustrie

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Projektsteuerung im EPC-Umfeld (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie eine Zertifizierung als PMP (Project Management Professional) und/oder AACE (Certified Cost Engineer)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Softwareanwendungen zur Kostensteuerung, beispielsweise Primavera P6, MSP und SAP

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Budgetplanung, Forecasting und Abweichungsanalysen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Software, beispielsweise Power BI, SAP oder Oracle

  • Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Kostensteuerung, insbesondere Earned Value Management (EVM)

Persönliche Kompetenzen

  • Sie treten als engagierter Repräsentant des Unternehmens auf, überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, den Projektfortschritt präzise und verständlich zu berichten

  • Sie sind teamorientiert und arbeiten effektiv mit anderen zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz

  • Sie arbeiten äußerst strukturiert, organisiert und eigeninitiativ

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft aus

  • Sie verfügen über sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Ihnen bieten

  • Sie arbeiten an einer der wichtigsten Zukunftstechnologien im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien in einem wachsenden Markt mit langfristigen Perspektiven

  • Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung

  • Sie profitieren von 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr

  • Sie erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld

  • Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen und erfahrenen Teams

  • Sie erhalten eine umfassende Einarbeitung sowie gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

title: Vice President - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
description:
Über Finton

Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt.

Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion.

Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist.

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projektleitung: Du führst Projekte mit Bestands- und Neukunden eigenständig, steuerst Scope, Timeline und Qualität und bringst Use Cases in wenigen Wochen vom Konzept in den Live-Betrieb.

  • Kundenverantwortung: Du trägst die P&L-Verantwortung für deine Mandate, erkennst Potenziale für Upselling und Cross-Selling und entwickelst deine Kunden zu langfristigen Partnerschaften.

  • Office of the CFO: Du analysierst bestehende Finanzprozesse, konzipierst Management Reporting, Cash Forecasting, Margen- und Umsatzanalysen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team auf den Systemen des Kunden um.

  • Sparring und Transaktionen: Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit CFOs und Geschäftsführern, unterstützt bei Budgets, Finanzmodellen, Bewertungen und begleitest Transaktionen, Fundraisings und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitungen.

  • Business Development: Du bringst dich in Angebote und Pitches ein, baust dein eigenes Netzwerk aus und gewinnst gemeinsam mit den Gründern neue Kunden.

  • Produktentwicklung: Mit Deinem Feedback unterstützt das Technologie-Team bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Platform.

  • Teamaufbau: Du führst und entwickelst jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen in deinen Projekten und prägst unsere Arbeitsweise mit.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Erfahrung: 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Financial Advisory (Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Consulting, Restructuring) oder im Office of the CFO eines Growth-Unternehmens, in dem du die Finanzabteilung mit aufgebaut hast.

  • Handwerk: Du hast Reporting, Budgets und Finanzmodelle gebaut und bringst Erfahrung in Unternehmensbewertung, M&A oder Fundraising mit.

  • Ausbildung: Überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Technologie: Begeisterung für AI und Prozessautomatisierung im Finanzwesen. Du musst nicht programmieren können, aber du willst verstehen, wie unsere Lösungen funktionieren, und sie beim Kunden überzeugend einsetzen.

  • Analytik: Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und ein Gespür für datenbasierte Unternehmenssteuerung.

  • Haltung: Unternehmerisches Denken, Eigenverantwortung und der Anspruch, Kunden und Umsatz selbst zu entwickeln.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine ersten Monate bei Finton

In den ersten Wochen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und arbeitest in bestehenden Projekten mit. Schnell übernimmst du eigene Kunden: Du analysierst deren Finanzprozesse, setzt erste Reporting- und Forecasting-Lösungen um und baust die Beziehung zum CFO auf.

Nach sechs Monaten verantwortest du ein eigenes Kundenportfolio inklusive Ergebnis, bringst dich in Angebote und Pitches ein und führst erste Teammitglieder in deinen Projekten. Dabei arbeitest du durchgängig direkt mit den Gründern zusammen.

Benefits

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Eigene Kunden, eigene P&L und direkter Zugang zu CFOs und Investoren. Keine Zwischenebenen, kein Folienproduzieren für andere.

  • Partner-Perspektive: Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad zum Partner mit strukturiertem Mentoring durch die Gründer.

  • Vergütung: Ein leistungsorientiertes Paket, das deine Erfahrung und deinen Beitrag zum Kundenergebnis widerspiegelt.

  • Technologie: Du arbeitest mit einer eigenen AI-Plattform statt mit Excel-Handarbeit und siehst, wie Finance-Arbeit in den nächsten Jahren aussehen wird.

  • Standort Köln: Unser Büro liegt am Friesenplatz, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort, weil die besten Ideen am Tisch nebenan entstehen und wir als kleines Team schnell entscheiden wollen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören dazu.

  • Ausstattung und Extras: Firmenlaptop, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Fitnessabo, kostenlose Getränke im Büro, lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

Bewerbung

Wenn du diesen Weg mitgestalten willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Ein Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Anfang; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Du hörst innerhalb von einer Woche von uns, und dein erstes Gespräch führst du direkt mit einem der Gründer.

Diesen Fokus erweitern wir um Softwareentwicklung, Architektur, Cloud, Data und AI. Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Expertise mit einem klaren Verständnis für Nutzerbedürfnisse, technische Anforderungen und die Ziele unserer Kunden. Wir arbeiten remote und legen Wert auf Eigenverantwortung, offene Kommunikation und eine Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst Datenplattformen und Datenarchitekturen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric und/oder Azure.

title: Business Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

We are looking for a Business Product Owner to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market leadership, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.

🎖️What success looks like

In your first month

  • You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

  • You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

By 3 months

  • Alongside our Product Owner, you contribute to defining a clear product vision and strategy, grounded in customer needs and market realities.

  • You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

  • You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

  • You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

By 6 months

  • You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

  • You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

  • You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

  • You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful:

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

  • You bring 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment, ideally in SaaS.

  • You are fluent in English. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

  • With the strong background in client-facing roles you bring, you know how to engage stakeholders at every level, bridging the gap between technical execution and executive leadership.

  • You have an interest in software development, are eager to learn new tools and technologies, and bring basic coding experience.

  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

  • You put the customer first, anticipate their needs, and focus on delivering solutions that improve satisfaction and the overall experience.

  • You are based in Munich and able to work from the office 3 days per week.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

We don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager & COO, Ksenia, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding, with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding session with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special milestones like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect – away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our COO & hiring manager, Ksenia.

  4. Raise the bar in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and CEO, Felix, in our Munich office.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. title: Founding Design Engineer | CodeSpeak
description:
Role: Founding Design Engineer (Senior / Staff)

Company: CodeSpeak

Location: London, on-site. Ideally you already live in London. Candidates based elsewhere are welcome to apply, and remote is possible for a very strong candidate, but UK-based candidates come first. Candidates with a Global Talent visa, granted or in process, are a good fit.

Job Type: Full-time

About CodeSpeak

Agents write more code every month. Human brains stay the same. CodeSpeak is building a program model that sits one level above code, so people can see how a program works and changes over time without reading much of it. The goal is to give control back to the developer: you think about architecture, and the routine goes away.

CodeSpeak was founded by Andrey Breslav, the creator of Kotlin, which millions of developers use daily. Around him is a team that has built the tools other engineers rely on, at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph, and Elastic. When it comes to program analysis and developer tooling, these are some of the best people in the world. CodeSpeak is backed by Accel and by funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, and funding covers several years.

Here is the open problem. The team has a fair idea of what the program model should look like. It does not yet know how to visualise it. As Founding Design Engineer you will decide how it looks, then build it and ship it. The core engineering team has just been hired, and nobody on it has design-engineering skills. You are the missing piece.

CodeSpeak is a UK company. It has no business in Russia and no ties to Russian companies. It is still testing which problems it can solve best, so priorities may shift.

What you are expected to do:

Design and delivery

  • Own how people interact with CodeSpeak: in the CLI, on the web and on any future platform.

  • Design the interfaces yourself. Build many prototypes, decide on the right UX and ship the result.

  • Harden the prototypes users liked, so they hold up on real data, with the same care for performance and product quality as for design.

  • Ship features to production without help from the rest of the team.

Product problems

CodeSpeak works with unusually complex information: developer intent, requirements, code, architecture, the relationships between them, how they change over time, contradictions and dependencies. The job is not to display it, but to help developers understand it, navigate it and act on it.

  • Find a way to visualise CodeSpeak's new, higher-level program model.

  • In your first 30 days, visualise the architecture of a codebase split into components. Go deeper from there: a single component, its diff and its code review.

  • Then interfaces that let developers navigate structured requirements and how they relate to each other, review requirements alongside code review, see how requirements map onto parts of the codebase, explore how intent, architecture and code change over time, browse agent sessions, find contradictions between requirements, and edit and reorganise requirements rather than only view them.

  • Web UI is the simplest and most obvious platform. Some of this will live in the console. VS Code plugins and other desktop frameworks may follow, and the final scope is still open.

Ways of working

  • Find tasks and clarify requirements without waiting for a brief. Nobody will micromanage you. Egor and Andrey give general direction.

  • Work directly with the founder and the engineering team to turn early ideas and hypotheses into intuitive, interactive product experiences.

  • Take part in design meetings, where many decisions are made on the spot.

  • Explain and defend your design decisions to Egor and Andrey. Both hold strong opinions, and both argue hard.

  • Argue for your tasks, and step back with good grace if the team disagrees.

What you need to succeed:

Craft

  • You can design an interface, prototype it and ship it to production on your own.

  • You have strong design taste, and your portfolio shows it: UX, interaction design, information architecture and visual hierarchy. For this role the portfolio is critical.

  • You make complex information or a complex data model easy to read. Think maps with metadata or dense dashboards, with non-trivial state. Tools that read and write count for more than infographics or landing pages.

  • You have solid computer science and software engineering fundamentals, plus TypeScript, and deep experience building production apps with modern UI frameworks such as React. At least 3 years of delivering production software.

  • You understand the problems of engineers, because engineers are CodeSpeak's users.

How you work

  • You can say why you made each design choice. "I'm an artist, I see it this way" will not work here.

  • You are curious and self-directed, and you care about making programming better. You gather requirements and find projects yourself.

  • You actively improve your own workflow with AI-powered coding tools.

  • You work hard and can be reached when a task needs it. The team has no weekend-work culture.

  • You think fast and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You speak Russian, which is the team's working language. This is a priority, not a hard rule, and a strong candidate without Russian will still be considered.

Nice to have

  • A background as a frontend engineer with good taste. Engineers from SwiftUI, desktop, mobile or full-stack are welcome if they visualise complex things very well.

  • Experience with complex data visualisation.

  • Some sense of what an early-stage startup is like. A big-tech engineer who knows what they are joining can fit, and so can a former co-founder.

A technical degree is not required. Self-taught people and people with degrees in geology or biology have done well in roles like this.

What you get:

  • An unsolved problem with real room for your taste. The team is inventing a new way to represent programs, and you decide how it looks.

  • A boutique team of strong engineers, built carefully, who have built developer tools at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph and Elastic.

  • An ML team of four, led by Emeli Dral. She co-founded Evidently, an evals startup, and co-authored a very popular Coursera course for data scientists.

  • Day-to-day work with Egor, Andrey and the tech lead.

  • Backing from Accel and from funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, with funding for several years.

  • A UK contract with a pension and medical insurance.

  • Autonomy. You set your own tasks and nobody hovers over you.

  • Work in AI, a field most people want to be in.

At Montu, every department plays an important role in delivering exceptional patient care. From our clinical and pharmacy teams to the people working behind the scenes, we all share the same goal of ensuring our patients receive the care, treatment and support they need.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Coordinator on a 12-month fixed-term cover contract, to join our Operations team at Kings Cross. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference.

With thousands of patients relying on our service, getting the little things right really does matter. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of a team that is helping to shape the future of medical cannabis in the UK.

This is a full-time, fixed-term contract for 12 months, working 40 hours per week.

 

About the Role

As a Prescription Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting our patients, clinicians and pharmacy teams, helping to ensure prescriptions are managed accurately and efficiently throughout the patient journey.

Working as part of our busy Operations team, you will be responsible for maintaining patient records, responding to enquiries, coordinating with internal and external teams and ensuring patients are kept informed about their prescriptions.

This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are quite the same. You will need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and patient care.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Responding to patient enquiries via telephone and email, providing a friendly, professional and helpful service.

  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic patient records and prescription information.

  • Working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to ensure prescriptions are processed efficiently and medication reaches patients without unnecessary delays.

  • Keeping patients informed of any changes or updates relating to their prescriptions.

  • Liaising with external pharmacy partners to ensure prescriptions are received, dispensed and delivered correctly.

  • Supporting our clinicians with day-to-day operational queries and ensuring they have the information they need.

  • Assisting with operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities when required.

  • Recording and escalating patient feedback, complaints, incidents and significant events in line with company procedures.

  • Working with our Governance team to ensure concerns are appropriately documented and addressed.

  • Liaising with our Product and Technology teams to help resolve technical issues affecting patients or clinicians.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes and working collaboratively with colleagues to make our service even better.

  • Maintaining compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures and mandatory training.

  • Supporting the wider team with operational activities and attending relevant meetings as required.

  • Demonstrating flexibility to support shift-based working when required.

     

What You Will Need

  • At least two years of experience in an administrative, customer service or operational role.

  • Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

  • Strong communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner.

  • A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others.

  • Good IT skills and the confidence to learn new systems and technology.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, compliance and following established procedures.

  • A proactive, adaptable attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to the continued improvement of our service.

     

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension contribution

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

  • The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business in an exciting and evolving area of healthcare

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued

     

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK.

Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support.

Compensation: £29.5K

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

  • Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

  • Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

  • Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

  • Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai.

  • Basic programming knowledge (e.g. JavaScript or Python) and working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication (OAuth, API keys), and data mapping.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

  • This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

  • Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with EDI, SFTP/flat-file integrations, or basic SQL.

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

title: Lead Database Administrator
description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans. 
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team! 

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay) 
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Our Mission:

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

 

About the role

  • Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

  • The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

  • A small team that ships fast. We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

 

What you’ll do

  • Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

  • Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

  • Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

  • Evolve our workflow builder: something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

  • Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

 

Who you are

  • You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

  • You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

  • You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

  • You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

  • You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

 

Interview process

  • An initial call with our talent team.

  • A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python.

  • An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).

  • Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.

  • Offer!

 

Compensation and benefits

We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be.

  • £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building

  • 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.)

  • Bupa private medical: £0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered, digital GP, plus Bupa dental

  • Fresh meal prep delivered every week, a stocked fridge, and team lunch out every Friday

  • Working late? Dinner’s on us, and so is your Uber home

  • Full visa sponsorship

  • New MacBook and whatever tools you need

  • Flexible parental leave, including adoption leave

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Améliorer de façon très significative la productivité des équipes par une meilleure utilisation des outils et une forte simplification.

Tu seras la/le responsable, l’interlocuteur.trice privilégié.e et la personne qui drive le changement au sein du département Customer Success (CS), aux côtés des managers opérationnels en charge des services professionnels, du support client et des chargés de comptes.

Nous recherchons un profil ambitieux, avec de précédentes expériences réussies sur des enjeux de transformation, d’amélioration de productivité et de gestion de projets.

- Expérience en transformation et amélioration de productivité par la mise en place de SI

- Une curiosité naturelle et l’envie de vraiment avoir de l’impact : capacité forte d’écoute et d’observation

- Expérience complète de la gestion de projet : tu sais cadrer un problème rapidement, livrer vite et itérer, sans attendre que tout soit parfait

- Capacité à, d’une part, descendre dans le détail et d’autre part, prendre du recul et analyser

- Mindset business

- Excellent(e) communicant(e) (à l’oral et à l’écrit), capacité à vulgariser un problème

- Appétences/connaissances sur l’IA, nocode, ou toute forme d’automatisation est souhaité

- La connaissance d'un département Customer Support ainsi que des outils Intercom, Zendesk et Salesforce est un plus

businesses and their accountants

the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of

Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding

ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000

accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Every great employee experience starts with great IT.

At Pennylane, our mission is to make technology simple, seamless and secure, so our

teams can focus on building the future of finance.

As an IT Support Administrator, you'll be one of the main points of contact for our

employees. You'll help them stay productive, improve the way we work and contribute to

building an IT environment that scales with our growth.

What you'll do

Deliver an outstanding IT experience

Whether it's resolving technical issues, answering questions or helping employees get the

most out of our tools, you'll make sure every Pennylaner has a smooth IT experience.

Employee onboarding & offboarding

You'll make sure every employee has everything they need before day one.

From day one to the last day, you'll make sure every employee has everything they

need to work successfully.

You'll prepare laptops, provision accounts, manage permissions and introduce new joiners to

our IT environment and security best practices.

You'll also handle offboarding and manage IT operations for freelancers and external

partners.

Keep our IT environment secure

Security is everyone's responsibility. You'll play an important role in making security part of

everyone's daily habits.

You'll help monitor compliance with our internal IT policies, manage software access, review

permissions and contribute to maintaining a secure environment for the whole company.

Manage our internal tools

You'll administer our SaaS ecosystem by creating accounts, managing permissions and

ensuring employees have the right access at the right time.

You'll also help improve how we manage and document our internal tools.

Share knowledge

You'll contribute to building a strong IT culture across the company.

That means writing clear documentation, improving our knowledge base, delivering

onboarding sessions and helping employees adopt best practices around IT and security.

Who are you?

We're looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong IT

fundamentals.

Someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people and continuously

improving the employee experience.

You won't know every tool we use on day one, and that's perfectly fine.

What matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability to take

ownership.
