At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We’re looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Senior Partner Manager (Strategic Partnerships) to build and scale Perk’s partner ecosystem across Europe, with a particular focus on the DACH region.

This is a commercial role with a clear objective: build partnerships that generate qualified sales pipeline and revenue for Perk. You’ll identify and recruit the right partners, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and turn those relationships into a repeatable growth channel. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing while owning partner relationships from initial outreach through launch, activation, and ongoing performance.

The ideal person combines a builder’s mindset with strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable opening doors, creating something from scratch, and earning the trust of senior stakeholders. You’re ambitious, persistent, and focused on measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential referral, reseller, technology, and strategic alliance partners across Europe, with a particular focus on DACH.

  • Generate pipeline and revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, turning partnerships into a meaningful and repeatable growth channel for Perk.

  • Create joint go-to-market strategies: Build plans with priority partners across target accounts, campaigns, events, referrals, and co-selling motions.

  • Own the commercial relationship: Lead partner conversations from initial outreach through business case development, negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing growth.

  • Activate and enable partners: Give partners the product knowledge, sales materials, training, and support they need to confidently position Perk and identify opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing: Ensure partner-generated opportunities are effectively routed, prioritised, and converted, while creating scalable ways for our commercial teams to work with partners.

  • Measure and improve performance: Set targets, forecast partner pipeline and revenue, identify what’s working, and continuously improve our partnership strategy and playbooks.

  • Bring new opportunities to Perk: Stay close to market and product developments and identify new partner models that can accelerate growth or create meaningful value for our customers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track record: Proven success in partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or business development, ideally within SaaS, fintech, travel technology, or another B2B technology environment.

  • ERP and finance technology ecosystem: Hands on experience working with ERP, accounting and finance automation vendors and their partner ecosystems (e.g Netsuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, Xero, Datev).

  • Commercial performance: A history of building partnerships that generate measurable sales pipeline and revenue against targets.

  • Builder mentality: Comfortable developing new partner relationships and go-to-market motions from scratch rather than simply managing an established programme.

  • Executive presence: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to build relationships and negotiate with senior and C-level stakeholders.

  • Commercial judgment: Able to assess which opportunities are worth pursuing, structure mutually valuable partnerships, and focus time on the relationships most likely to produce meaningful results.

  • Cross-functional mindset: A low-ego, team-first approach and the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other teams.

  • Ownership: Independent, ambitious, persistent, and comfortable being accountable for outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our hub.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe for partner meetings, conferences and events.

What we offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit:

  • In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner.

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden.

  • Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys.

  • Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends.

  • Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

  • Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen.

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden.

  • Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern.

  • Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil.

  • Migration Solution Architecture: Designing end-to-end migration solutions covering data extraction, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation and exception management, ensuring alignment with Kaluza architecture and engineering standards.

title: Ground Software Engineer - Core
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Core team within Ground Platform. The team develops the core capabilities that support Loft's ground platform, improve development workflows, and ensure platform reliability. You'll help build shared services and tools that benefit software teams across Loft.

You'll work on backend services, workflow automation, AI tooling, and platform infrastructure, with a focus on observability and reliability. You'll also have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, helping investigate anomalies and supporting real-time incident response when needed.

If you're excited about improving how software is developed across Loft, contributing to key technical decisions, and building more reliable platform systems, we'd love to hear from you.


About this role:
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies and software patterns that propagate to the entire Loft's software stack
  • Lead the creation and evolution of Loft's AI tooling for development, review, and spacecraft anomaly investigation
  • Develop central ground platform functionalities such as workflow automation, microservice inter-communication, and metrics
  • Take responsibility for the reliability and performance of Loft's ground platform infrastructure, including message queues, CI/CD, and observability
  • Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies and supporting real‑time incident response when needed
  • Collaborate with software engineers and satellite operators from all over the company to support and foster consistent, maintainable, and performant software solutions

Must Haves:
  • Solid backend software development experience
  • Hands-on knowledge of deployment and Infrastructure as Code
  • Ability to define and maintain CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working with Kubernetes

Nice to Haves:
  • Python development, particularly with Django
  • Knowledge of GraphQL and Graphene
  • Experience with message queues and streaming technologies (NATS)
  • Knowledge of DevOps and observability tools (Helm, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, etc)
  • Familiarity with AI tooling
  • Frontend development with Vue and Web Components

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Account Executive - SMB Inbound (Inside Sales)
description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Mission Principale :
 
En tant qu'Account Executive SMB, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille clients en traitant l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la qualification des leads entrants jusqu’au closing.
 
Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM, en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients.
 
 
Responsabilités :
 
1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral :
- Qualification des leads entrants : Identifier et prioriser les leads générés par le marketing ou d'autres canaux, avec un focus sur les entreprises SMB (1 à 5 juristes).
- Compréhension des besoins clients : Mener des découvertes approfondies et efficaces pour comprendre les défis et besoins spécifiques des prospects afin de proposer la solution la plus adaptée.
- Présentation des solutions : Démonstration de notre plateforme SaaS et de ses fonctionnalités en lien avec les enjeux des prospects.
- Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature.
 
2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales :
- Utilisation proactive du CRM pour tenir à jour les opportunités, le pipeline de vente, et assurer un suivi rigoureux des prospects.
- Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes
- Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline
 
3. Collaboration interservices :
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Produit et Customer Success pour assurer une excellente expérience client.
- Remonter les feedbacks des prospects et clients pour améliorer le produit et les processus commerciaux.
 
4. Développement de la connaissance marché :
- Maintenir une veille active sur les évolutions du secteur juridique et des besoins spécifiques des entreprises juridiques SMB.
- Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché.
 
Objectifs et KPIs :
- Honorer un nombre de volume rdvs journaliers issus de la qualification de leads entrants.
- Taux de conversion des leads entrants en opportunités qualifiées.
- Allier qualité et opportunisme dans traitement des salescycle pour convertir avec le meilleur Sales Cycle.
- Atteinte des quotas de vente mensuels et trimestriels.

Compétences requises :
  • Expérience commerciale : Expérience significative en tant qu’Account Executive, Business Developer ou poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou dans la vente de solutions B2B.
  • Cycle de vente complet : Capacité prouvée à gérer un cycle de vente de bout en bout (qualification, négociation, closing).
  • Orienté résultats : Forte capacité à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente, avec un excellent sens des priorités.
  • Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés.

    • Qualités personnelles :
  • Autonomie et proactivité : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement startup en forte croissance.
  • Écoute active : Vous êtes à l’écoute des besoins de vos interlocuteurs et savez adapter votre discours en conséquence.
  • Esprit d'équipe : Vous aimez collaborer avec les autres départements pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
  • Adaptabilité : Vous êtes flexible et capable de vous adapter rapidement aux changements dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Résilience : Vous avez une forte capacité à surmonter les obstacles et à persévérer pour atteindre vos objectifs.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.

title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
description:
Le rôle

Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation.

Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel.

Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.


Tes missions 🎯

•    comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery

•    identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre

•    concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable

•    prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée

•    accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence

•    intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision


Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents

Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.

Décider ce qui se mutualise

Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.


Avec qui tu travailles 🤝

  • Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.

  •  

    Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.


    • Ton profil 🚀

    Une culture Tech large

    Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.

    Une vraie profondeur IA

    Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

    Du jugement, et des mains

    Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir.

    Une culture Product et client

    Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

    Apprécié

    Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus.


    Pourquoi Thiga 👀

    Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

    Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet.

    Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec.


    Process de recrutement 🎢

    1.   Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle.

    2.   Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil.

    3.   Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés.

    Notre culture
     
    Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts :
    Product first 
    Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure.
    Hands-on or nothing 
    Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie.
    Market Maker by Design 
    Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations.
    Knowledge Open Bar 
    Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils.

title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
description:
Mindset

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé.

La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif, en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable.

C’est là qu’intervient l’AI Product Ops.

Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux.

Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter.

Le job

En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA.

Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle.

Tu es à la fois :

  • un profil hands-on, capable de builder pour montrer l’exemple ;

  • un profil ops, capable de simplifier et fiabiliser les workflows ;

  • un profil change, capable d’embarquer les équipes dans de nouvelles pratiques ;

Concrètement, dans le cadre de tes missions, tu seras amené·e à

  • Auditer les processus de discovery, delivery et go-to-market pour identifier les frictions, les tâches à faible valeur, les dépendances inutiles et les opportunités de délégation à l’IA.

  • Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

  • Designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, en clarifiant les rôles, les responsabilités, les points de contrôle et les conditions de réussite.

  • Mettre en place les outils, standards et rituels nécessaires à une exécution plus fluide : documentation, pilotage, reporting, coordination, partage de connaissance, qualité d’exécution.

  • Builder toi-même des skills, assistants, automatisations ou agents simples adaptés au contexte client, pour outiller des usages concrets et immédiats.

  • Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible.

  • Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail.

  • Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être.

  • Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

  • des workflows de discovery et de delivery revus, simplifiés et mieux maîtrisés ;

  • des usages IA prioritaires cadrés, outillés et réellement adoptés ;

  • plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ;

  • une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ;

  • une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective.

  • la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ;

Ce que ce rôle n’est pas

Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire :

  • du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ;

  • du portfolio management ;

  • de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;

  • de l’industrialisation technique à grande échelle ;

L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’efficience organisationnelle, du build, et de la conduite du changement.

Qui es-tu ?

Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience, avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

Tu es probablement :

  • un·e coach agile aguerri au passé de dev, ayant une approche hands-on

  • un·e Product Ops senior ;

  • ou un·e Product Manager avec une très forte fibre ops ;

Et surtout :

  • Tu as déjà travaillé au sein d’équipes produit, au plus près du delivery et de la réalité terrain.

  • Tu sais analyser un flux de valeur de développement, repérer les goulots d’étranglement, et transformer une friction en dispositif concret.

  • Tu sais tirer parti de copilotes, assistants, outils d’automatisation, outils de documentation augmentée et solutions d’orchestration légère.

  • Tu es capable de builder toi-même des agents ou assistants simples, sans prétendre être la personne qui les industrialisera techniquement à grande échelle.

  • Tu sais passer de l’idée à l’outil, puis de l’outil à l’adoption.

  • Tu es à l’aise aussi bien avec des équipes opérationnelles qu’avec des interlocuteurs de direction.

  • Tu as suffisamment de culture produit pour ne pas confondre vitesse et valeur.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment.

Ton savoir-être

  • Tu es énergique, pragmatique et orienté impact.

  • Tu aimes autant transformer un mode de fonctionnement que mettre les mains dans les outils.

  • Tu sais embarquer sans évangéliser dans le vide.

  • Tu as une posture de partenaire exigeant : direct, utile, crédible.

  • Tu navigues bien entre technique, produit, organisation et business.

  • Tu sais faire avancer un sujet même quand tout n’est pas encore cadré.

Et en interne, au sein de Thiga

  • Tu interviens comme consultant·e en mission, au plus près des enjeux clients.

  • Tu contribues au développement de l’offre AI Product Ops / POM-AI avec le référent de l’offre.

  • Tu participes à la production de contenu, à la capitalisation, au partage interne et à certaines démarches d’avant-vente.

description:
👫  About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️  What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪  About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

description:
Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology.  

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures.  

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients.

  • Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities.  

  • Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.  

  • Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development.

  • Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines.

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers.  

  • Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture.  

  • Coach team members in both technical and professional development.  

  • Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery.  

Product Development 

  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.  

  • Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components.  

  • Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code.  

  • Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions.  

Scientific & External Collaboration 

  • Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events.  

  • Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners.  

  • Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. 


Your Profile

Education & Experience 

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field.  

  • 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment.  

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists.

  • Strong programming skills in Python.

title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (EMEA)
description:
Build a Safer World.

As an EMEA Public Sector Deployment Strategist, you will own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of public sector customers across the region, including law enforcement agencies, regulators, and government teams working some of the most complex cases in crypto-related crime. You will own onboarding, adoption, outcomes and the relationship across all TRM products, including Ardence, our newest and fastest-moving product. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts. You will define what success looks like for each customer, prove it with usage and outcomes, and enable the renewals and expansion that follow alongside our Account Directors.

The impact you will have:

  • Onboard and activate your EMEA Public Sector accounts across all TRM products, with a clear onboarding path and measurable hands-on-keyboard usage for every account in your portfolio

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts — compressing hours of reporting prep into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio — hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics — and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

Team Operating Rhythms:

We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.

  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
  • Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
  • A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
  • Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
  • The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
  • A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

  2. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.
